passage.quote:
Correspondence is established in separate layers. The tensor calculation and
ordered assembly must first agree with the Lean specification without assuming
associativity of rounded addition. A binary64 instruction interpretation must
then connect actual register and memory execution to those calculations. The
parallel dot-product order is part of the GPU algorithm, so the solver's result
is not required to be bitwise identical to the CPU PCG loop.

summary: Prove that accepted binary64 solutions have zero boundary and satisfy the exact requested fresh-residual bound for the represented discrete equations.
Connect ordered cell arithmetic to TorchLean, preserving separate rounded multiply/add operations and freedom in NaN encodings.
Derive register setup, connectivity gathering, shared-store ownership, barrier history and later read visibility from one fetched cell execution.
Prove publication of the actual whole-cell TorchLean tensor using decoded coefficient tables and an explicit equal-dimension condition.
Prove complete assembly entry correctness, memory safety and execution existence from physical arrays, including masking and padded return.
Derive assembly input reads from the same joint source history, using input/output separation and actual offset/index bounds; publish its actual stores as the ordered rounded scatter.
Construct an admitted returning parallel assembly execution for every valid input, independently of the universal correctness theorem.
Connect complete true_residual entry and whole-vector subtraction to the specification under necessary byte-source constraints.
Bind emitted instructions to Lean representations and keep kernel proofs, source-fidelity review, compiled checks and saved GPU observations distinct.
Keep arbitrary-input whole-cell existence, setup serialization, remaining solver instructions, launch composition, complete PTX admission and hardware correspondence explicit.
Decode ordered assembly tables and compose actual cell publications with assembly to obtain the TorchLean tensor operator; exercise the connection with a nonzero kernel-checked example.
Connect the ordered tensor operator to the executable array reference, preserving its original scatter order and input validation.

Compose actual cell instruction interleavings with private shared-memory identity and derived source contracts; chronological publication followed by assembly yields the executable TorchLean operator.
Construct grid scheduling and admitted sources from supplied complete local cell runs, while keeping arbitrary-input local existence separate.
Connect actual cell and assembly publication to fresh-residual subtraction, deriving preservation of the right-hand side from store bounds.
Derive repeated shared-word read sources from actual ordering and explicit necessary coherence constraints; distinguish obsolete and future writes from initialization.
Derive each active binary64 reduction update, its fetched execution and allocation bounds; concurrent stage visibility and the whole reduction remain separate.
Derive reduction sources from lane ownership and shrinking stage coverage, and check a completed two-stage concurrent witness; full emitted-entry coverage remains open.
Derive every shared-tree read source from actual 256-lane control, address preparation and barrier publications; native entry translation remains separate.

Prove every completed admitted shared-tree run computes the prescribed rounded reduction; construct a complete admitted execution for arbitrary initial words and bound every access within its 2048-byte allocation.
Relate separately scheduled unsigned lane comparisons and predicated branches to the shared-tree guard, deriving outcomes from preserved registers and retaining the emitted instruction order.
Derive the strided input accumulation from actual global loads, separate rounded multiply/add operations and nonwrapping 32-bit index progress.

Recover every returned lane’s rounded input partial sum from the complete concurrent dot program and its actual byte sources; derive input footprints and output-address ownership, while tree composition and final output value remain unfinished.
remaining: Arbitrary-input cell execution existence, external coefficient/index serialization, remaining solver/reduction instructions and host/launch orchestration remain open. Complete PTX admission and CUDA/hardware correspondence remain outside the fragment claim.

from.quote:
A correspondence proof must explain what the GPU computes, rather than assume
that an operator call already has the right answer. The local cell calculation
uses five phases separated by barriers. Each lane computes one matrix entry,
with a sequential sequence of multiply and add operations. The proof relates
that ordered calculation to the actual TorchLean matrix-product definition.
It must not rearrange rounded sums using identities valid only over real numbers.

theorem cell_float_correspondence (b d w u : Mat Float n n) :
    cell (entries b) (entries d) (entries w) (entries u) =
      entries (localAction b d w u) :=
  cell_correspondence Binary64.mul_comm b d w u

from.quote:
Assembly adds the contributions for a global node in element order. Filtering
other nodes' contributions out of that order must preserve its value even when
addition is not associative. Writes to different nodes may be scheduled in any
order because each node has one writer.

passage.quote:
theorem scatter_gather [DecidableEq ι] [Add α]
    (contributions : List (ι × α)) (s : ι → α) (node : ι) :
    (contributions.foldl scatterStep s) node =
      (contributions.filter fun entry => entry.1 == node).foldl
        (fun acc entry => acc + entry.2) (s node) := by
  induction contributions generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih]
    by_cases h : x.1 = node
    · simp [h, scatterStep]
    · simp [h, scatterStep, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm h)]

from.quote:
The GPU's dot product partitions inputs among 256 lanes, then combines partial
sums in a tree. That ordering belongs to its numerical specification. Agreement
with a sequential CPU dot product is not a universal bitwise property. The
solver must be related to its own rounded operations and fresh residual check;
a different iteration history is not itself a correctness failure.

Binary64 arithmetic uses the pinned Lean logical Float model. FloatLib supplies
the exact dyadic decoding used by the residual checker and proved arithmetic
bridges under explicit finiteness conditions.
Those logical bridges do not themselves establish the behavior of a compiler
or physical GPU.

theorem decodeWord_real (word : BitVec 64) (q : ℚ) (h : decodeWord word = some q) :
    (q : ℝ) = (Model.ofBits word : Model FloatFormat.binary64).toReal := by
  unfold decodeWord at h
  cases hd : (Model.ofBits word : Model FloatFormat.binary64).toDyadic? with
  | none => simp [hd] at h
  | some d =>
    simp only [hd, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h, FloatLib.Numerics.Dyadic.cast_toRat, Model.toReal_eq, hd]

from.quote:
The accepted whole-solver guarantee is an a posteriori residual certificate: a
check of the actual returned solution, independent of how the solver obtained
it. Exact rational arithmetic interprets the saved binary64 basis, derivative,
weight, load and solution words. NaNs, infinities, malformed shapes and altered
uniform connectivity are rejected. The coefficient values are the represented
setup values, not ideal quadrature recomputed over real numbers.

passage.quote:
def parse (j : Json) : Except String Request := do
  let side ← natField j "n"
  let degree ← natField j "degree"
  if side == 0 || degree < 1 || degree > 4 then throw "expected positive n and degree 1..4"
  let m := degree+1
  let width := side*degree+1
  let v := width*width
  let e := side*side
  let cellsJson ← (← field j "cells").getArr?
  let cells ← cellsJson.mapM fun value => do
    let k ← value.getNat?
    if h : k < v then pure (⟨k,h⟩ : Fin v) else throw "cell node outside mesh"
  let cells ← sized cells ((e*m)*m)
  let b ← sized (← words j "B") (m*m)
  let d ← sized (← words j "D") (m*m)
  let w ← sized (← words j "W") (m*m)
  let rhs ← sized (← words j "load") v
  let x ← sized (← words j "solution") v
  let rtol ← decode (← field j "rtol")
  let atol ← decode (← field j "atol")
  let mesh : Connectivity e m v := ⟨fun element i j => cells (index (index element i) j)⟩
  -- Reject a different mesh even when its indices are in range.
  for element in List.finRange e do
    for i in List.finRange m do
      for k in List.finRange m do
        let expected := (element.val/side*degree+i.val)*width+element.val%side*degree+k.val
        if (mesh.node element i k).val != expected then throw "nonuniform connectivity"
  let p : Problem e m v := {
    mesh := mesh
    b := matrix fun i j => b (index i j)
    d := matrix fun i j => d (index i j)
    w := matrix fun i j => w (index i j)
    rhs := rhs
    boundary := fun i => i.val%width == 0 || i.val%width == width-1 || i.val/width == 0 || i.val/width == width-1
    rtol := rtol, atol := atol }
  return ⟨e,m,v,p,x⟩

from.quote:
Acceptance requires zero boundary values and
`‖b − A x‖₂ ≤ max(atol, rtol · ‖b‖₂)` on interior nodes, where A uses the
TorchLean tensor operator in exact arithmetic. The check compares squared
rational quantities, avoiding any rounded square root or empirical allowance.
The soundness theorem applies to every accepted vector and does not assume
PTX correctness, PCG convergence or agreement with the CPU iteration history.
All rounding in the returned solution is included by checking its exact stored
values. Successful GPU status alone is insufficient for acceptance.

passage.quote:
theorem certified_residual (p : Problem e n v) (x : Fin v → ℚ)
    (accepted : check p x = true) :
    (∀ i, p.boundary i = true → x i = 0) ∧
      realNorm (residual p x) ≤
        max (p.atol : ℝ) ((p.rtol : ℝ) * realNorm (fun i => if p.boundary i then 0 else p.rhs i)) := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hr,hboundary,hbound⟩ := check_sound p x accepted
  refine ⟨hboundary, ?_⟩
  have ha' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p.atol := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hr' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p.rtol := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have bound : ((squareSum (residual p x) : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ ((thresholdSquare p : ℚ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hbound
  apply (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt bound).trans_eq
  simp only [thresholdSquare, Rat.cast_max, Rat.cast_mul]
  rw [(show Monotone Real.sqrt from fun _ _ h => Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h).map_max, Real.sqrt_mul (mul_nonneg hr' hr')]
  simp only [Real.sqrt_mul_self ha', Real.sqrt_mul_self hr', realNorm, rhsSquare]

def computedApply (p : Problem e n v) (x : Fin v → ℚ) : Vector ℚ v :=
  (tensorContributions p.mesh p.b p.d p.w x).foldl scatterVectorStep (Vector.replicate v 0)

theorem computedApply_get (p : Problem e n v) (x : Fin v → ℚ) (i : Fin v) :

passage.quote:
theorem acceptedRequest_sound (j : Json) (h : acceptedRequest j = true) :
    ∃ (e n v : Nat) (p : Problem e n v) (x : Fin v → ℚ),
      parse j = .ok ⟨e,n,v,p,x⟩ ∧
      (∀ i, p.boundary i = true → x i = 0) ∧
      realNorm (residual p x) ≤
        max (p.atol : ℝ) ((p.rtol : ℝ) * realNorm (fun i => if p.boundary i then 0 else p.rhs i)) := by
  cases hp : parse j with
  | error error => simp [acceptedRequest,hp] at h
  | ok request =>
    rcases request with ⟨e,n,v,p,x⟩
    exact ⟨e,n,v,p,x,rfl,certified_residual p x (by simpa [acceptedRequest,hp] using h)⟩

from.quote:
This establishes a result certificate, not an instruction-refinement theorem.
It does not prove that every GPU execution will terminate or pass the check,
and it gives no continuous PDE error or conditioning-based solution-error bound.
Compiled checker execution, input/output transport, and a particular saved GPU
run retain their stated runtime and provenance boundaries.

passage.quote:
def certify(run_directory, output):
    run_directory = run_directory.resolve()
    output = output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    source_hashes = proof_sources()
    report = {'schema_version': 1, 'status': 'running', 'checks': [], 'skipped': [],
              'proof_sources_sha256': source_hashes,
              'theorem': 'PtxTorchLean.Poisson.Certificate.certified_residual',
              'claim': 'Exact requested residual bound and zero boundary for represented setup coefficients; no PDE or PTX trace theorem.'}
    try:
        run = json.loads((run_directory / 'report.json').read_text())
        if run['numerical_status'] != 'pass':
            raise ValueError('requires a completed numerical run')
        for name, expected in run['artifacts'].items():
            path = run_directory / name
            path.resolve().relative_to(run_directory)
            if digest(path) != expected:
                raise ValueError(f'artifact hash mismatch: {name}')
        report['run_artifacts'] = run['artifacts']
        version, log = build()
        report['lean_version'] = version
        (output / 'build.log').write_text(log)
        selected = []
        for case in run['cases']:
            folder = run_directory / case['directory']
            observed = json.loads((folder / 'observed.json').read_text())
            if observed['reason'] != case['reason']:
                raise ValueError('case status mismatch')
            if observed['reason'] == 'converged':
                selected.append((case['directory'], request(folder)))
            else:
                report['skipped'].append({'directory': case['directory'], 'reason': observed['reason']})
        if not selected:
            raise ValueError('no converged results to certify')
        status, results = run_checker([r for _, r in selected], output / 'inputs.json', output / 'outputs.json')
        if len(results) != len(selected):
            raise ValueError('certificate count mismatch')
        for (name, _), result in zip(selected, results, strict=True):
            report['checks'].append({'directory': name, **result})
        if status or any(r.get('accepted') is not True for r in results):
            raise AssertionError('a GPU result failed the exact residual/boundary certificate')

        # Negative controls bind acceptance to values, boundary, shape and finite
        # decoding. They cannot pass merely because the source run said converged.
        sample = next(r for _, r in selected if r['n'] == 2 and r['degree'] == 1)
        bad_boundary = copy.deepcopy(sample)
        bad_boundary['solution'][0] = 0x3ff0000000000000
        bad_interior = copy.deepcopy(sample)
        bad_interior['solution'][4] = 0
        nonfinite = copy.deepcopy(sample)
        nonfinite['W'][0] = 0x7ff0000000000000
        wrong_shape = copy.deepcopy(sample)
        wrong_shape['B'].pop()
        bad_mesh = copy.deepcopy(sample)
        bad_mesh['cells'][0] = 1
        status, rejected = run_checker([bad_boundary, bad_interior, nonfinite, wrong_shape, bad_mesh],
                                       output / 'negative-inputs.json', output / 'negative-outputs.json')
        if status == 0 or len(rejected) != 5 or any(r.get('accepted') is True for r in rejected):
            raise AssertionError('negative certificate controls were not rejected')
        report['negative_controls'] = ['nonzero boundary', 'wrong interior solution',
                                       'nonfinite weight', 'wrong basis shape', 'wrong connectivity']
        if proof_sources() != source_hashes:
            raise AssertionError('proof/checker sources changed during certification')
        report['artifacts'] = {p.name: digest(p) for p in sorted(output.iterdir()) if p.is_file()}
        report['status'] = 'pass'
        save(output / 'certification.json', report)
        print(f'Exact Lean residual certificates passed: {len(results)} GPU solutions; 5 negative controls rejected.', flush=True)
        return report
    except BaseException as e:
        report['status'] = 'fail'
        report['error'] = str(e)
        save(output / 'certification.json', report)
        raise

theorem array_coordinate (ctx : Context) (s final : State) (count : BitVec 32)
    (rhs ap output : Word) (i : Fin count.toNat)
    (threadIndex : (index ctx).toNat = i.val)
    (pc : s.core.pc = 0) (running : s.halted = false)
    (start : s.core.globalStart = ctx.arena.toNat)
    (aligned : ctx.arena.toNat % 8 = 0)
    (arenaBound : ctx.arena.toNat+s.core.globalBytes ≤ 2^64)
    (fields : ∀ off ∈ [rhs,ap,output], off.toNat % 8 = 0 ∧
      off.toNat+count.toNat*8 ≤ s.core.globalBytes)
    (execution : Run ctx (program count rhs ap output) s final) :
    decode (read64 final.core.global (ctx.arena.toNat+i.val*8+output.toNat)) =
      (TorchLean.Tensor.subSpec
        (view s.core.global (fun j : Fin count.toNat => ctx.arena.toNat+j.val*8+rhs.toNat))
        (view s.core.global (fun j : Fin count.toNat => ctx.arena.toNat+j.val*8+ap.toNat))) (i,PUnit.unit) := by
  have hl : live ctx count := by unfold live; rw [threadIndex]; exact i.isLt
  have valid (off : Word) (h : off ∈ [rhs,ap,output]) :=
    field_valid ctx s count off hl start aligned (fields off h).1 (fields off h).2 arenaBound
  have addressExact (off : Word) (h : off ∈ [rhs,ap,output]) :
      (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 off).toNat = ctx.arena.toNat+i.val*8+off.toNat := by
    have hf := (fields off h).2
    have hi := i.isLt
    rw [setup_address,address64_exact _ _ _ (by rw [threadIndex]; omega),threadIndex]
  have hr := torchlean_coordinate ctx s final count rhs ap output i
    (fun j => ctx.arena.toNat+j.val*8+rhs.toNat)
    (fun j => ctx.arena.toNat+j.val*8+ap.toNat)
    (addressExact rhs (by simp)).symm (addressExact ap (by simp)).symm
    pc running hl (valid rhs (by simp)) (valid ap (by simp)) (valid output (by simp)) execution
  simpa only [addressExact output (by simp)] using hr

theorem fetched_correct (ctx : Context) (s final : State) (count : BitVec 32) (rhs ap output : Word)
    (pc : s.core.pc = 0) (running : s.halted = false) (hl : live ctx count)
    (hr : Valid64 s.core.globalStart s.core.globalBytes (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 rhs).toNat)
    (ha : Valid64 s.core.globalStart s.core.globalBytes (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 ap).toNat)
    (ho : Valid64 s.core.globalStart s.core.globalBytes (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 output).toNat)
    (execution : Run ctx (program count rhs ap output) s final) :
    decode (read64 final.core.global (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 output).toNat) =
      decode (read64 s.core.global (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 rhs).toNat) -
      decode (read64 s.core.global (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 ap).toNat) ∧

theorem fetched_frame (ctx : Context) (s final : State) (count : BitVec 32) (rhs ap output : Word)
    (pc : s.core.pc = 0) (running : s.halted = false) (hl : live ctx count)
    (hr : Valid64 s.core.globalStart s.core.globalBytes (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 rhs).toNat)
    (ha : Valid64 s.core.globalStart s.core.globalBytes (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 ap).toNat)
    (ho : Valid64 s.core.globalStart s.core.globalBytes (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 output).toNat)
    (execution : Run ctx (program count rhs ap output) s final) :
    (∀ p, p < (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 output).toNat ∨
      (address (setup ctx s count).core 12 output).toNat+8 ≤ p → final.core.global p = s.core.global p) ∧
    final.core.shared = s.core.shared := by
  have he : Exec ctx (program count rhs ap output) s final := run_exec execution [] _ rfl pc
  have hb : Exec ctx ((PTX.Residual.code rhs ap output).map Instr.data ++ [.ret]) (setup ctx s count) final :=
    (prologue_live hl running).mp (by simpa only [program,List.append_assoc] using he)
  obtain ⟨middle,hbody,hret⟩ := exec_block hb
  have runMiddle : ({setup ctx s count with core := middle} : State).halted = false := setup_live hl running
  have hend := (exec_halting_iff (i := .ret) (by simp) runMiddle rfl).mp hret
  subst final
  have h := PTX.Residual.correct _ _ rhs ap output
    (by simpa using hr) (by simpa using ha) (by simpa using ho) hbody
  simpa [simple,halt,advance,PTX.advance] using h.2

theorem Arena.correspondence (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (regs : Fin n → Registers)
    (c : Candidate (a.inputs memory regs)) (source)
    (compatible : Compatible memory (events (a.inputs memory regs) c) source)
    (order : List (Fin n)) (complete : ∀ i, i∈order) :
    Kernel.Residual.view (publish (a.inputs memory regs) c order)
        (fun i : Fin n => a.base.toNat+i.val*8+a.output.toNat) =
      TorchLean.Tensor.subSpec
        (Kernel.Residual.view memory (fun i : Fin n => a.base.toNat+i.val*8+a.rhs.toNat))
        (Kernel.Residual.view memory (fun i : Fin n => a.base.toNat+i.val*8+a.ap.toNat)) := by
  have h:=torchlean_output (a.inputs memory regs) c source compatible
    (a.input_separation memory regs) (a.output_ownership memory regs) order complete
  change Kernel.Residual.view (publish (a.inputs memory regs) c order)
    (fun i => (a.inputs memory regs).addr i a.output) =
      TorchLean.Tensor.subSpec
        (Kernel.Residual.view memory (fun i => (a.inputs memory regs).addr i a.rhs))
        (Kernel.Residual.view memory (fun i => (a.inputs memory regs).addr i a.ap)) at h
  simpa only [a.addr memory regs _ a.output (by simp),
    a.addr memory regs _ a.rhs (by simp), a.addr memory regs _ a.ap (by simp)] using h

theorem padding (ctx : Context) (s : Kernel.State) (count : BitVec 32)
    (rhs ap output : Word) (choose : Nat → Word) (fuel : Nat)
    (pc : s.core.pc=0) (running : s.halted=false) (inactive : ¬Kernel.Residual.live ctx count) :
    execute ctx (Kernel.Residual.program count rhs ap output) choose (fuel+6) s =
      some (Kernel.Residual.setup ctx s count,[]) := by
  have hge : count.toNat ≤ (Kernel.Residual.index ctx).toNat := Nat.le_of_not_gt inactive

recovers every producer's word and preserves all bytes outside the plane.

theorem order_independent (initial : Memory) (base width plane : Nat)
    (final : Fin (width*width) → State) (left right : List (Fin (width*width)))
    (hl : ∀ i, i∈left) (hr : ∀ i, i∈right) :
    publish initial base width plane final left = publish initial base width plane final right := by
  funext p
  by_cases covered : ∃ i : Fin (width*width), ∃ k : Fin 8, p=address base width plane i.val+k.val
  · obtain ⟨i,k,rfl⟩ := covered
    have l := congrArg (fun w => byte w k.val) (published_word initial base width plane final left i (hl i))
    have r := congrArg (fun w => byte w k.val) (published_word initial base width plane final right i (hr i))
    simpa only [Sources.byte_read64] using l.trans r.symm
  · have outside : ∀ i : Fin (width*width), p<address base width plane i.val ∨
        address base width plane i.val+8≤p := by
      intro i
      by_contra h
      have hk : p-address base width plane i.val<8 := by omega
      exact covered ⟨i,⟨p-address base width plane i.val,hk⟩,by simp; omega⟩
    rw [published_outside _ _ _ _ _ _ _ outside,published_outside _ _ _ _ _ _ _ outside]

    (valid : ∀ i, SharedStore.Valid (start i) offset)
    (locations : ∀ i, (SharedStore.location (start i) offset).toNat=address base width plane i.val)
    (execution : ∀ i, Block (Contraction.program width acc a b ++ SharedStore.code offset acc)
      (start i) (final i)) (i : Fin (width*width)) :
    decode (read64 (publish initial base width plane final order) (address base width plane i.val)) =
      Spec.get2 (Spec.matMulSpec (Contraction.leftTensor (start i) width a)
        (Contraction.rightTensor (start i) width b)) 0 0 := by
  rw [published_word _ _ _ _ _ _ i (complete i)]

      i.val=((m.row.operand k).eval s).toNat*width+((m.column.operand k).eval s).toNat ∧

theorem completed_arrivals {cfg : Config n} {s : State n}
    (run : Runs cfg program s events final) (reset : s.barrier = Barrier.reset generation) :
    CompleteOrigins events := by
  have aligned : Aligned s := by intro t ht; simp [reset,Barrier.reset] at ht

site and reuse number, and releases only after every participant arrives at that
same site.

    (pcs : ∀ t, (s.lanes t).pc=0) (reset : s.barrier=Barrier.reset 0) (site : s.site=none) :
    ∃ events, Runs cfg [.sync 0,.sync 0] s events (afterRound (afterRound s 0) 1) := by
  obtain ⟨first,hfirst⟩ := barrier_round_exists cfg s [.sync 0,.sync 0] 0 0 pcs reset site rfl
  obtain ⟨second,hsecond⟩ := barrier_round_exists cfg (afterRound s 0) [.sync 0,.sync 0] 1 1

  exact ⟨first++second,runs_append hfirst hsecond⟩

from.quote:

addresses and the absence of any other writer then force all eight read bytes
to come from that store.

passage.quote:
theorem read_from_writer (compatible : Compatible initial events source)
    (performed : Performed events source)
    (hw : events[w]?=some (.data writer wa)) (hr : events[r]?=some (.data reader ra))
    (write : wa.data.store=true) (read : ra.data.store=false)
    (sw : wa.space=.shared) (sr : ra.space=.shared)
    (same : wa.data.address=ra.data.address) (ordered : Across events w r)
    (owner : SoleWriter events w ra.data.address) :
    ra.data.value=wa.data.value ∧ ∀ k, source r k=.store w k := by
  have chosen : ∀ k, source r k=.store w k ∧ byte ra.data.value k.val=byte wa.data.value k.val := by
    intro k
    have comp := compatible r reader ra hr read k
    cases hs : source r k with
    | initial => exact False.elim (performed w r writer reader wa ra hw hr write read sw sr ordered k k (by rw [same]) hs)
    | store other j =>
      simp only [hs] at comp
      obtain ⟨t,a,ha,store,space,address,value⟩ := comp
      have eq : other=w := owner other t a ha store (space.trans sr) j k address
      subst other
      have accessEq : a=wa := by have := Option.some.inj (ha.symm.trans hw); cases this; rfl
      subst a
      have jk : j=k := by apply Fin.ext; omega
      subst j
      exact ⟨rfl,value⟩
  exact ⟨Sources.word_eq_of_bytes _ _ (fun k => (chosen k).2),fun k => (chosen k).1⟩

theorem step_access_origin (h : Step cfg program thread s out)
    (member : Event.data owner access ∈ out.events) :
    owner=thread ∧ ∃ op next,
      program[(s.lanes thread).pc]?=some (.data op) ∧ Data op (s.lanes thread) next (some access) := by
  obtain ⟨fresh,i,fetch,dispatch⟩ := h
  cases dispatch with
  | data h =>
    cases ha : ‹Option Access› with
    | none => simp [ha] at member
    | some actual =>

      obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := member

  | skip => simp at member
  | sync =>
    simp only [synchronize] at member
    split at member <;> simp_all

split and both fetched subruns. Instruction counters stay absolute in the
execution: arithmetic starts at counter 21. The proof translates its local
view in both directions, including branch destinations, data records and
barrier sites. A barrier generation counts completed uses of the barrier;
events before and after the first release use different generations, so
translating later sites leaves the earlier barrier's identity unchanged.

actual global-store history. Layout, represented input arrays, necessary
byte-source admission and completion of the active lanes remain explicit
premises. Coefficient tables are still decoded initial inputs.

      (entry start) before indices (entry ready))
    (aligned : Concurrent.Aligned start.core) (pcs : ∀ u, (start.core.lanes u).pc=0)
    (done : ∀ u, (ready.core.lanes u).pc=21)
    (body : Concurrent.WithTail.Runs cfg ctx (Concurrent.CellConsumer.WithOutput.front width)
      (CellFinal.tail width output) (CellEntry.continuation (entry ready)) after localFinal) :
    ∃ renameKey, Concurrent.Relabel.Related renameKey (before++after) (before++after.map (Relocate.event 21)) := by
  obtain ⟨allPC,site,generation,key,reset,rest⟩ := CellEntry.completed_barrier first aligned

def scalar (offset : Nat) (s : PTX.State) : PTX.State := {s with pc:=s.pc+offset}

@[simp] theorem scalar_pc : (scalar offset s).pc=s.pc+offset := rfl

@[simp] theorem scalar_regs : (scalar offset s).regs=s.regs := rfl

@[simp] theorem operand : Operand.eval (scalar offset s) op=Operand.eval s op := by
  cases op <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem scalar_advance : scalar offset (advance s)=advance (scalar offset s) := by
  simp [scalar,advance,Nat.add_right_comm]

@[simp] theorem scalar_assign : scalar offset (assign s r w)=assign (scalar offset s) r w := by
  simp [scalar,assign,advance,Nat.add_right_comm]

@[simp] theorem scalar_put : scalar offset (put s sp a w)=put (scalar offset s) sp a w := by
  cases sp <;> simp [scalar,put,advance,Nat.add_right_comm]

@[simp] theorem memory : (scalar offset s).memory sp=s.memory sp := by cases sp <;> rfl
@[simp] theorem start : (scalar offset s).start sp=s.start sp := by cases sp <;> rfl
@[simp] theorem bytes : (scalar offset s).bytes sp=s.bytes sp := by cases sp <;> rfl

/-- Arithmetic and memory effects commute with moving the instruction origin. -/
theorem eval (step : PTX.Eval op s t) : PTX.Eval op (scalar offset s) (scalar offset t) := by
  cases step with
  | mov => simpa using (PTX.Eval.mov (s:=scalar offset _) (dst:=_) (src:=_))
  | mul32 => simpa using (PTX.Eval.mul32 (s:=scalar offset _) (dst:=_) (a:=_) (b:=_))
  | add32 => simpa using (PTX.Eval.add32 (s:=scalar offset _) (dst:=_) (a:=_) (b:=_))
  | add64 => simpa using (PTX.Eval.add64 (s:=scalar offset _) (dst:=_) (a:=_) (b:=_))
  | wide8 => simpa using (PTX.Eval.wide8 (s:=scalar offset _) (dst:=_) (index:=_))
  | load64 valid =>
    simpa using (PTX.Eval.load64 (s:=scalar offset _) (dst:=_) (address:=_) (space:=_) (by simpa using valid))
  | store64 valid =>
    simpa using (PTX.Eval.store64 (s:=scalar offset _) (address:=_) (src:=_) (space:=_) (by simpa using valid))
  | fp allowed =>
    simpa using (PTX.Eval.fp (s:=scalar offset _) (dst:=_) (a:=_) (b:=_) (op:=_) (out:=_) (by simpa using allowed))


def access (offset : Nat) (a : Concurrent.Access) : Concurrent.Access :=
  {a with data:={a.data with pc:=a.data.pc+offset}}

def key (offset : Nat) (k : Ptx.Barrier.Key) : Ptx.Barrier.Key := {k with site:=k.site+offset}

def barrierEvent (offset : Nat) : Ptx.Barrier.Event n → Ptx.Barrier.Event n
  | .arrival k t => .arrival (key offset k) t
  | .completion k => .completion (key offset k)

def event (offset : Nat) : Concurrent.Event n → Concurrent.Event n
  | .data t a => .data t (access offset a)
  | .barrier e => .barrier (barrierEvent offset e)

def core (offset : Nat) (s : Concurrent.State n) : Concurrent.State n :=
  ⟨fun t => scalar offset (s.lanes t),s.barrier,s.site.map (·+offset)⟩

def outcome (offset : Nat) (s : Concurrent.Outcome n) : Concurrent.Outcome n :=
  ⟨core offset s.state,s.events.map (event offset)⟩

theorem key_injective : Function.Injective (key offset) := by
  intro a b h
  cases a; cases b
  simpa [key,Ptx.Barrier.Key.mk.injEq] using h

  cases step with
  | ordinary plain he => simpa using Concurrent.Data.ordinary plain (eval (offset:=offset) he)

    simpa only [scalar_assign,Option.map_some,access,operand,scalar_pc] using (Concurrent.Data.load (s:=scalar offset _) (sp:=_) (dst:=_) (addr:=_) (word:=_)

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Concurrent.AtOffset

/-- Fetched execution at an absolute instruction origin. The counter, records
and barrier sites remain absolute; only list indexing subtracts the origin.
Branch destinations are relocated before dispatch. -/
inductive Step (origin : Nat) (cfg : Config n) (ctx : Fin n → Kernel.Context)
    (front : List Instr) (tail : List Kernel.Instr) : Fin n → WithTail.State n → WithTail.Outcome n → Prop where
  | front (running : s.halted thread=false) (fresh : s.core.barrier.arrived thread=false)
      (past : origin≤(s.core.lanes thread).pc)
      (fetch : front[(s.core.lanes thread).pc-origin]?=some i)
      (dispatch : Concurrent.Dispatch cfg thread (Relocate.instruction origin i) s.core out) :
      Step origin cfg ctx front tail thread s ⟨{s with core:=out.state},out.events⟩
  | tail (running : s.halted thread=false) (fresh : s.core.barrier.arrived thread=false)
      (past : origin+front.length≤(s.core.lanes thread).pc)
      (fetch : tail[(s.core.lanes thread).pc-(origin+front.length)]?=some i)
      (eval : Kernel.Eval (ctx thread) i (WithTail.lane s thread) next) :
      Step origin cfg ctx front tail thread s
        ⟨WithTail.update s thread next,(WithTail.access i (WithTail.lane s thread) next).toList.map (Event.data thread)⟩

inductive Runs (origin : Nat) (cfg : Config n) (ctx : Fin n → Kernel.Context)
    (front : List Instr) (tail : List Kernel.Instr) : WithTail.State n → List (Event n) → WithTail.State n → Prop where
  | nil : Runs origin cfg ctx front tail s [] s
  | cons : Step origin cfg ctx front tail thread s out → Runs origin cfg ctx front tail out.state rest final →
      Runs origin cfg ctx front tail s (out.events++rest) final

variable {n : Nat} {cfg : Config n} {ctx : Fin n → Kernel.Context}
  {s start final : WithTail.State n} {out : WithTail.Outcome n}

theorem aligned (step : Step origin cfg ctx front tail thread s out) (aligned : Concurrent.Aligned s.core) :
    Concurrent.Aligned out.state.core := by
  cases step with
  | front _ fresh _ _ dispatch =>
    generalize hi : Relocate.instruction origin _=i at dispatch
    cases dispatch with
    | data => exact setLane_aligned aligned fresh _
    | skip => exact setLane_aligned aligned fresh _
    | sync => exact synchronize_aligned _ _ _ _ aligned
  | tail _ fresh _ _ _ => exact setLane_aligned aligned fresh _

/-- A local fetched step relocates to an absolute fetched step. -/
theorem step_forward (step : WithTail.Step cfg ctx front tail thread s out) :
    Step origin cfg ctx front tail thread (Relocate.tailState origin s) (Relocate.tailOutcome origin out) := by
  cases step with
  | front running one =>
    obtain ⟨fresh,i,fetch,dispatch⟩ := one
    have next := Step.front (s:=Relocate.tailState origin s) (origin:=origin) (front:=front)
      (tail:=tail) (ctx:=ctx) (cfg:=cfg) running fresh (by simp [Relocate.tailState,Relocate.core,Relocate.scalar])
      (by simpa [Relocate.tailState,Relocate.core,Relocate.scalar] using fetch)
      (Relocate.dispatch dispatch)
    simpa only [Relocate.tailOutcome,Relocate.tailState,Relocate.outcome] using next
  | tail running fresh past fetch eval =>
    rename_i i actualNext
    have bound : origin+front.length≤((Relocate.tailState origin s).core.lanes thread).pc := by
      change origin+front.length≤(s.core.lanes thread).pc+origin; omega
    have seen : tail[((Relocate.tailState origin s).core.lanes thread).pc-(origin+front.length)]?=some i := by
      simpa [Relocate.tailState,Relocate.core,Relocate.scalar,Nat.add_sub_add_right,Nat.add_comm origin] using fetch
    have next := Step.tail (s:=Relocate.tailState origin s) (origin:=origin) (front:=front)
      (tail:=tail) (ctx:=ctx) (cfg:=cfg) running fresh bound seen (Relocate.kernel_eval (offset:=origin) eval)
    simpa [Relocate.tailOutcome,Relocate.event,List.map_map,Function.comp_def,Option.toList_map] using next

/-- Recover local execution from every absolute step starting in a relocated
state. No schedule, numerical result or intermediate state is supplied. -/
theorem step_back (step : Step origin cfg ctx front tail thread (Relocate.tailState origin s) out) :
    ∃ localOut, out=Relocate.tailOutcome origin localOut ∧ WithTail.Step cfg ctx front tail thread s localOut := by
  cases step with
  | front running fresh past fetch dispatch =>
    obtain ⟨localOut,same,localStep⟩ := Relocate.dispatch_back dispatch
    refine ⟨⟨{s with core:=localOut.state},localOut.events⟩,?_,WithTail.Step.front running ⟨fresh,_,?_,localStep⟩⟩
    · simp [same,Relocate.tailOutcome,Relocate.tailState,Relocate.outcome]
    · simpa [Relocate.tailState,Relocate.core,Relocate.scalar] using fetch
  | tail running fresh past fetch eval =>
    rename_i i actualNext
    obtain ⟨next,same,localStep⟩ := Relocate.kernel_back (s:=WithTail.lane s thread) (offset:=origin) (by simpa only [Relocate.tail_lane] using eval)
    have bound : front.length≤(s.core.lanes thread).pc := by
      change origin+front.length≤(s.core.lanes thread).pc+origin at past; omega
    have seen : tail[(s.core.lanes thread).pc-front.length]?=some i := by
      simpa [Relocate.tailState,Relocate.core,Relocate.scalar,Nat.add_sub_add_right,Nat.add_comm origin] using fetch
    refine ⟨_,?_,WithTail.Step.tail running fresh bound seen localStep⟩
    simp [same,Relocate.tailOutcome,Relocate.event,List.map_map,Function.comp_def,Option.toList_map]

theorem run_forward (run : WithTail.Runs cfg ctx front tail s events t) :
    Runs origin cfg ctx front tail (Relocate.tailState origin s) (events.map (Relocate.event origin))
      (Relocate.tailState origin t) := by
  induction run with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons one rest ih => simpa [List.map_append,Relocate.tailOutcome] using Runs.cons (step_forward one) ih

theorem run_back (run : Runs origin cfg ctx front tail start events final)
    (same : start=Relocate.tailState origin s) :
    ∃ localEvents localFinal, events=localEvents.map (Relocate.event origin) ∧
      final=Relocate.tailState origin localFinal ∧ WithTail.Runs cfg ctx front tail s localEvents localFinal := by
  induction run generalizing s with
  | nil => exact ⟨[],s,rfl,same,.nil⟩
  | cons one rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨localOut,outEq,localStep⟩ := step_back (same ▸ one)
    obtain ⟨last,done,eventsEq,finalEq,path⟩ := ih (s:=localOut.state) (by rw [outEq]; rfl)
    refine ⟨localOut.events++last,done,?_,finalEq,.cons localStep path⟩
    simp [outEq,eventsEq,Relocate.tailOutcome,List.map_append]

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Concurrent.Relabel

/-- Counter labels may change; all accessed bytes, values and participants stay
identical. A common barrier-key renaming is used throughout the history. -/
inductive EventRelated (renameKey : Ptx.Barrier.Key → Ptx.Barrier.Key) : Event n → Event n → Prop where
  | data : EventRelated renameKey (.data thread ⟨space,⟨pc,store,byteAddress,value⟩⟩)
      (.data thread ⟨space,⟨otherPC,store,byteAddress,value⟩⟩)
  | arrival : EventRelated renameKey (.barrier (.arrival key thread)) (.barrier (.arrival (renameKey key) thread))
  | completion : EventRelated renameKey (.barrier (.completion key)) (.barrier (.completion (renameKey key)))

abbrev Related (renameKey : Ptx.Barrier.Key → Ptx.Barrier.Key) (old new : List (Event n)) :=
  List.Forall₂ (EventRelated renameKey) old new

variable {n : Nat} {old new : List (Event n)} {e : Event n} {r : Nat}

theorem at_old (related : Related renameKey old new) (observed : old[r]?=some e) :
    ∃ other, new[r]?=some other ∧ EventRelated renameKey e other := by
  induction related generalizing r with
  | nil => simp at observed
  | cons one rest ih =>
    cases r with
    | zero => simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero,Option.some.injEq] at observed; subst e; exact ⟨_,rfl,one⟩
    | succ r => exact ih observed

theorem at_new (related : Related renameKey old new) (observed : new[r]?=some e) :
    ∃ other, old[r]?=some other ∧ EventRelated renameKey other e := by
  induction related generalizing r with
  | nil => simp at observed
  | cons one rest ih =>
    cases r with
    | zero => simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero,Option.some.injEq] at observed; subst e; exact ⟨_,rfl,one⟩
    | succ r => exact ih observed

/-- Source admission is invariant under counter and barrier-label changes.
This direction is the one needed to use the local proof on an absolute run. -/
theorem compatible (related : Related renameKey old new)
    (admitted : Visibility.Compatible initial new source) : Visibility.Compatible initial old source := by
  intro r reader ra observed read k
  obtain ⟨other,seen,record⟩ := at_old related observed
  cases record with
  | data =>
    have h := admitted r reader _ seen read k
    cases chosen : source r k with
    | initial => simpa only [chosen] using h
    | store w j =>
      simp only [chosen] at h ⊢
      obtain ⟨writer,wa,writeSeen,store,space,address,value⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨oldWrite,oldSeen,writeRecord⟩ := at_new related writeSeen
      cases writeRecord
      exact ⟨writer,_,oldSeen,store,space,address,value⟩

theorem across (related : Related renameKey old new) (ordered : Visibility.Across old w r) :
    Visibility.Across new w r := by
  obtain ⟨writer,reader,wa,ra,key,a,c,hw,hr,ha,hc,before,middle,after⟩ := ordered
  obtain ⟨_,hw,writeRecord⟩ := at_old related hw
  obtain ⟨_,hr,readRecord⟩ := at_old related hr
  obtain ⟨_,ha,arrivalRecord⟩ := at_old related ha
  obtain ⟨_,hc,completionRecord⟩ := at_old related hc
  cases writeRecord; cases readRecord; cases arrivalRecord; cases completionRecord
  exact ⟨writer,reader,_,_,renameKey key,a,c,hw,hr,ha,hc,before,middle,after⟩

  obtain ⟨_,hr,readRecord⟩ := at_old related hr

  intro r reader ra observed k

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Concurrent.Relabel

/-- The prefix keeps its sites; subsequent barrier generations use relocated
sites. The cut is determined by the actual first-barrier reset. -/
def renameAfter (cut offset : Nat) (key : Ptx.Barrier.Key) : Ptx.Barrier.Key :=
  if cut≤key.generation then Relocate.key offset key else key

variable {n : Nat} {e : Event n} {events before after : List (Event n)}

theorem before_event (bound : ∀ b, e=.barrier b → Clock.generation b<cut) :
    EventRelated (renameAfter cut offset) e e := by
  cases e with
  | data thread access => cases access with | mk space data => cases data; exact .data
  | barrier b =>
    have early := bound b rfl
    cases b with
    | arrival key thread =>
      change key.generation<cut at early
      simpa [renameAfter,Nat.not_le.mpr early] using
        (EventRelated.arrival (renameKey:=renameAfter cut offset) (key:=key) (thread:=thread))
    | completion key =>
      change key.generation<cut at early
      simpa [renameAfter,Nat.not_le.mpr early] using
        (EventRelated.completion (renameKey:=renameAfter cut offset) (key:=key))

theorem after_event (bound : ∀ b, e=.barrier b → cut≤Clock.generation b) :
    EventRelated (renameAfter cut offset) e (Relocate.event offset e) := by
  cases e with
  | data thread access => cases access with | mk space data => cases data; exact .data
  | barrier b =>
    have late := bound b rfl
    cases b with
    | arrival key thread =>
      change cut≤key.generation at late
      simpa [renameAfter,late,Relocate.event,Relocate.barrierEvent] using
        (EventRelated.arrival (renameKey:=renameAfter cut offset) (key:=key) (thread:=thread))
    | completion key =>
      change cut≤key.generation at late
      simpa [renameAfter,late,Relocate.event,Relocate.barrierEvent] using
        (EventRelated.completion (renameKey:=renameAfter cut offset) (key:=key))

theorem before_history (bound : ∀ b, Event.barrier b∈events → Clock.generation b<cut) :
    Related (renameAfter cut offset) events events := by
  induction events with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons e rest ih =>
    exact .cons (before_event (fun b same => bound b (by simp [same])))
      (ih (fun b member => bound b (by simp [member])))

theorem after_history (bound : ∀ b, Event.barrier b∈events → cut≤Clock.generation b) :
    Related (renameAfter cut offset) events (events.map (Relocate.event offset)) := by
  induction events with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons e rest ih =>
    exact .cons (after_event (fun b same => bound b (by simp [same])))
      (ih (fun b member => bound b (by simp [member])))

/-- A real completed generation separates old prefix sites from body sites.
Only labels change; byte sources retain exactly the same event positions. -/
theorem joined (first : Clock.Progress initial (Ptx.Barrier.reset cut) before)
    (second : Clock.Progress (Ptx.Barrier.reset cut) final after) :
    Related (renameAfter cut offset) (before++after) (before++after.map (Relocate.event offset)) := by
  apply List.rel_append
  · exact before_history (fun b member => Clock.before_reset (first.emitted b member).2)
  · exact after_history (fun b member => (second.emitted b member).1)

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Concurrent.Clock
open Ptx

/-- An arrival still in the current generation has an actual waiting bit.
Completions always belong to an older generation. -/
def Before (state : Barrier.State n) : Barrier.Event n → Prop
  | .arrival key thread => key.generation<state.generation ∨
      (key.generation=state.generation ∧ state.arrived thread=true)
  | .completion key => key.generation<state.generation

def generation : Barrier.Event n → Nat
  | .arrival key _ | .completion key => key.generation

theorem monotone (cfg : Barrier.Config n) (s : Barrier.State n) (r : Barrier.Request n) :
    s.generation≤(Barrier.step cfg s r).state.generation := by
  unfold Barrier.step
  dsimp only
  split
  · split
    · exact Nat.le_refl _
    · split <;> simp [Barrier.mark,Barrier.reset]
  · exact Nat.le_refl _

variable {n : Nat} {s : Barrier.State n} {event : Barrier.Event n}

theorem carry (before : Before s event) (cfg : Barrier.Config n) (r : Barrier.Request n) :
    Before (Barrier.step cfg s r).state event := by
  unfold Barrier.step
  dsimp only
  split
  · split
    · exact before
    · split
      · cases event <;> simp only [Before,Barrier.reset] at before ⊢ <;> omega
      · cases event with
        | completion key => exact before
        | arrival key thread =>
          rcases before with past | ⟨same,waiting⟩
          · exact Or.inl past
          · exact Or.inr ⟨same,Barrier.mark_monotone s r.thread thread waiting⟩
  · exact before

variable {n : Nat} {cfg : Barrier.Config n} {s : Barrier.State n}
  {r : Barrier.Request n} {event : Barrier.Event n}

theorem emitted (member : event∈(Barrier.step cfg s r).events) :
    generation event=s.generation ∧ Before (Barrier.step cfg s r).state event := by
  unfold Barrier.step at member ⊢
  dsimp only at member ⊢
  split at member
  · rename_i same
    have gen : r.key.generation=s.generation := by
      have h := congrArg Barrier.Key.generation same
      simpa only [Barrier.key] using h
    split at member
    · simp at member
    · rename_i fresh
      split at member
      · rename_i complete
        simp only [same,fresh,complete,↓reduceIte]
        simp only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at member
        rcases member with rfl|rfl <;> simp [generation,Before,gen,Barrier.reset]
      · rename_i incomplete
        simp only [same,fresh,incomplete,↓reduceIte]
        simp only [List.mem_singleton] at member
        subst event
        exact ⟨gen,Or.inr ⟨gen,by simp [Barrier.mark]⟩⟩
  · simp at member

/-- Reset state means no arrival from its current generation has happened. -/
theorem before_reset (before : Before (Barrier.reset next) event) : generation event<next := by
  cases event <;> simpa [Before,generation,Barrier.reset] using before

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Concurrent.Clock
open Ptx

/-- Barrier history facts composable across arbitrary instruction schedules. -/
structure Progress (s t : Barrier.State n) (events : List (Event n)) : Prop where
  monotone : s.generation≤t.generation
  carries : ∀ event, Before s event → Before t event
  emitted : ∀ event, Event.barrier event∈events → s.generation≤generation event ∧ Before t event

theorem Progress.refl (s : Barrier.State n) : Progress s s [] :=
  ⟨le_rfl,fun _ h => h,by intro event member; simp at member⟩

theorem Progress.trans (first : Progress s t before) (second : Progress t u after) :
    Progress s u (before++after) := by
  refine ⟨first.monotone.trans second.monotone,fun e h => second.carries e (first.carries e h),?_⟩
  intro event member
  rcases List.mem_append.mp member with early | late
  · have h := first.emitted event early
    exact ⟨h.1,second.carries event h.2⟩
  · have h := second.emitted event late
    exact ⟨first.monotone.trans h.1,h.2⟩

theorem unchanged (same : t=s) (none : ∀ event, Event.barrier event∉events) : Progress s t events := by
  subst t
  exact ⟨le_rfl,fun _ h => h,fun e h => False.elim (none e h)⟩

theorem sync_barrier (cfg : Config n) (s : State n) (thread : Fin n) (resource : Fin 16) :
    (synchronize cfg s thread resource).state.barrier=
      (Barrier.step (barrierConfig cfg s thread) s.barrier (barrierRequest cfg s thread resource)).state := by
  by_cases same : (barrierRequest cfg s thread resource).key=Barrier.key (barrierConfig cfg s thread) s.barrier <;>
    by_cases old : s.barrier.arrived (barrierRequest cfg s thread resource).thread=true <;>
    by_cases complete : Barrier.Complete (Barrier.mark s.barrier (barrierRequest cfg s thread resource).thread) <;>
    simp [synchronize,Barrier.step,same,old,complete]

theorem sync_events (cfg : Config n) (s : State n) (thread : Fin n) (resource : Fin 16) :
    (synchronize cfg s thread resource).events=
      (Barrier.step (barrierConfig cfg s thread) s.barrier (barrierRequest cfg s thread resource)).events.map Event.barrier := by
  by_cases same : (barrierRequest cfg s thread resource).key=Barrier.key (barrierConfig cfg s thread) s.barrier <;>
    by_cases old : s.barrier.arrived (barrierRequest cfg s thread resource).thread=true <;>
    by_cases complete : Barrier.Complete (Barrier.mark s.barrier (barrierRequest cfg s thread resource).thread) <;>
    simp [synchronize,Barrier.step,same,old,complete]

theorem sync_progress (cfg : Config n) (s : State n) (thread : Fin n) (resource : Fin 16) :
    Progress s.barrier (synchronize cfg s thread resource).state.barrier (synchronize cfg s thread resource).events := by
  rw [sync_barrier,sync_events]
  refine ⟨monotone _ _ _,fun event h => carry h _ _,?_⟩
  intro event member
  have actual : event∈(Barrier.step (barrierConfig cfg s thread) s.barrier (barrierRequest cfg s thread resource)).events := by
    simpa using member
  have h := emitted actual
  exact ⟨by omega,h.2⟩

variable {n : Nat} {cfg : Config n} {s : State n} {out : Outcome n}

theorem dispatch_progress (step : Dispatch cfg thread i s out) : Progress s.barrier out.state.barrier out.events := by
  cases step with
  | data => exact unchanged rfl (by intro event; simp)
  | skip => exact unchanged rfl (by intro event; simp)
  | sync => exact sync_progress _ _ _ _

end PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Concurrent.Clock

theorem clock_step (step : Step cfg ctx code thread s out) :
    Concurrent.Clock.Progress s.core.barrier out.state.core.barrier out.events := by
  obtain ⟨fresh,i,fetch,dispatch⟩ := step
  cases dispatch with
  | setup => exact Concurrent.Clock.unchanged rfl (by intro event; simp)
  | gather => exact Concurrent.Clock.unchanged rfl (by intro event; simp)
  | skip => exact Concurrent.Clock.unchanged rfl (by intro event; simp)
  | sync => exact Concurrent.Clock.sync_progress _ _ _ _

theorem clock_run (run : Runs cfg ctx code s events indices t) :
    Concurrent.Clock.Progress s.core.barrier t.core.barrier events := by
  induction run with
  | nil => exact Concurrent.Clock.Progress.refl _
  | cons one rest ih => exact (clock_step one).trans ih

def OutputLayout (bases : Space → Word) (cell : BitVec 32) (width : Nat) (output : Word) : Prop :=
  ∀ u : Fin 32, cell.toNat*(width*width)+u.val<2^32 ∧
    (bases .global).toNat+(cell.toNat*(width*width)+u.val)*8+output.toNat<2^64

  unfold OutputLayout
  infer_instance

    (fun u => CellEntry.Control.initial (s:=CellEntry.lane (entry start) u) (pcs u)) positive fits

  have lane := (control u).2.2.1 (by omega)

variable {before after : List (Concurrent.Event 32)}

def begin (s : CellEntry.State 32) : State := ⟨s.core,s.live,fun _ => false⟩

theorem append (first : Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx s before firstIndices t)
    (second : Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx t after lastIndices u) :
    Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx s (before++after) (firstIndices++lastIndices) u := by
  induction first with
  | nil => exact second
  | cons one rest ih => simpa [List.append_assoc] using Runs.cons one (ih second)

theorem prefix_run
    (run : CellEntry.Runs cfg (CellPrologue.threadContext bases cell) (CellEntry.program width cells source)
      s events indices t) :
    Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx (begin s) events indices (begin t) := by
  induction run with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons one rest ih => exact .cons (.entry rfl one) ih

theorem offset_run
    (run : Concurrent.AtOffset.Runs 21 cfg ctx (Concurrent.CellConsumer.WithOutput.front width)
      (CellFinal.tail width output) s events t) :
    Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx s events [] t := by
  induction run with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons one rest ih => exact .cons (.body one) ih

must really have completed; no shared snapshot is installed at the join. -/
theorem compose
    (first : CellEntry.Runs cfg (CellPrologue.threadContext bases cell) (CellEntry.program width cells source)
      s before indices ready)
    (pcs : ∀ u, (ready.core.lanes u).pc=21) (site : ready.core.site=none)
    (body : Concurrent.WithTail.Runs cfg ctx (Concurrent.CellConsumer.WithOutput.front width)
      (CellFinal.tail width output) (CellEntry.continuation ready) after final) :
    Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx (begin s)
      (before++after.map (Relocate.event 21)) indices (Relocate.tailState 21 final) := by
  have shifted : begin ready=Relocate.tailState 21 (CellEntry.continuation ready) :=
    ready_view (ready:=begin ready) pcs site (fun _ => rfl)
  have later := offset_run (bases:=bases) (cell:=cell) (cells:=cells) (source:=source)
    (Concurrent.AtOffset.run_forward (origin:=21) body)
  rw [← shifted] at later
  simpa using append (prefix_run first) later

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.CellWhole

/-- Native-counter control facts computed from the fetched Lean instruction
lists. PTX labels are zero-length markers and are not instructions. -/
def shape (width : Nat) (cells source output : Word) : Nat × List Nat × List (Nat × Nat) :=
  let entry := CellEntry.program width cells source
  let front := Concurrent.CellConsumer.WithOutput.front width
  let barriers := (entry.zipIdx.filterMap fun (op,pc) => match op with
    | .sync => some pc | _ => none) ++
    (front.zipIdx.filterMap fun (op,pc) => match op with
      | .sync _ => some (entry.length+pc) | _ => none)
  let branches := (entry.zipIdx.filterMap fun (op,pc) => match op with
    | .skip target => some (pc,target) | _ => none) ++
    (front.zipIdx.filterMap fun (op,pc) => match op with
      | .skip _ target => some (entry.length+pc,entry.length+target) | _ => none)
  (entry.length+front.length+(CellFinal.tail width output).length,barriers,branches)

abbrev State := Concurrent.WithTail.State 32

def entry (s : State) : CellEntry.State 32 := ⟨s.core,s.predicate⟩

def entryState (s : State) (next : CellEntry.State 32) : State :=
  ⟨next.core,next.live,s.halted⟩

structure Outcome where
  state : State
  events : List (Concurrent.Event 32)
  indices : List (Fin 32 × IndexSources.Access)

/-- One fetched execution of the entry, arithmetic and output tail. Prefix
fetching ends at 21; the body uses absolute counters and relocated branch and
barrier sites. There is no externally supplied cut or transition schedule. -/
inductive Step (cfg : Concurrent.Config 32) (bases : Space → Word) (cell : BitVec 32)
    (width : Nat) (cells source output : Word) (ctx : Fin 32 → Kernel.Context) :
    Fin 32 → State → Outcome → Prop where
  | entry (running : s.halted thread=false)
      (step : CellEntry.Step cfg (CellPrologue.threadContext bases cell) (CellEntry.program width cells source)
        thread (entry s) out) :
      Step cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx thread s
        ⟨entryState s out.state,out.events,out.indices⟩
  | body (step : Concurrent.AtOffset.Step 21 cfg ctx (Concurrent.CellConsumer.WithOutput.front width)
      (CellFinal.tail width output) thread s out) :
      Step cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx thread s ⟨out.state,out.events,[]⟩

inductive Runs (cfg : Concurrent.Config 32) (bases : Space → Word) (cell : BitVec 32)
    (width : Nat) (cells source output : Word) (ctx : Fin 32 → Kernel.Context) :
    State → List (Concurrent.Event 32) → List (Fin 32 × IndexSources.Access) → State → Prop where
  | nil : Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx s [] [] s
  | cons : Step cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx thread s out →
      Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx out.state events indices final →
      Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx s (out.events++events) (out.indices++indices) final

theorem step_aligned (step : Step cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx thread s out)
    (aligned : Concurrent.Aligned s.core) : Concurrent.Aligned out.state.core := by
  cases step with
  | entry _ one => exact CellEntry.step_aligned one aligned
  | body one => exact Concurrent.AtOffset.aligned one aligned

/-- Before the first barrier, a full-entry step must be a real prefix step. -/
theorem before (step : Step cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx thread s out)
    (early : (s.core.lanes thread).pc≤20) :
    CellEntry.Step cfg (CellPrologue.threadContext bases cell) (CellEntry.program width cells source)
      thread (entry s) ⟨entry out.state,out.events,out.indices⟩ ∧ out.state.halted=s.halted := by
  cases step with
  | entry _ one => exact ⟨one,rfl⟩
  | body one => cases one <;> omega

/-- The first real release determines the cut and preserves every register,
byte and flag. All thirty-two lanes, including padding, have reached it. -/
theorem split (run : Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx start events indices final)
    (aligned : Concurrent.Aligned start.core)
    (early : ∀ u, (start.core.lanes u).pc≤20) (running : ∀ u, start.halted u=false)
    (thread : Fin 32) (finished : 20<(final.core.lanes thread).pc) :
    ∃ first later firstIndices laterIndices ready,
      events=first++later ∧ indices=firstIndices++laterIndices ∧
      CellEntry.Runs cfg (CellPrologue.threadContext bases cell) (CellEntry.program width cells source)
        (entry start) first firstIndices (entry ready) ∧
      (∀ u, (ready.core.lanes u).pc=21) ∧ ready.core.site=none ∧
      (∀ u, ready.halted u=false) ∧
      Runs cfg bases cell width cells source output ctx ready later laterIndices final := by
  induction run with
  | nil => have := early thread; omega

    have prefixStep := before one (early selected)
    have nextRunning : ∀ u, out.state.halted u=false := by rw [prefixStep.2]; exact running

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Flow

/-- The unsigned comparisons used by the node assembly and reduction loops. -/
inductive Compare where
  | ge | ne | lt
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Compare.apply (comparison : Compare) (a b : Word) : Bool :=
  match comparison with
  | .ge => decide ((Kernel.u32 a).toNat ≥ (Kernel.u32 b).toNat)
  | .ne => Kernel.u32 a != Kernel.u32 b
  | .lt => decide ((Kernel.u32 a).toNat < (Kernel.u32 b).toNat)

inductive Source where
  | arena | lane | group
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def source (ctx : Kernel.Context) : Source → Word
  | .arena => ctx.arena
  | .lane => ctx.lane.setWidth 64
  | .group => ctx.group.setWidth 64

inductive Instr where
  | data (op : Indexed.Instr)
  | context (dst : Nat) (src : Source)
  | compare (dst : Nat) (comparison : Compare) (a b : Operand)
  | branch (predicate : Nat) (when : Bool) (target : Nat)
  | jump (target : Nat)
  | select (predicate : Nat) (when : Bool) (dst : Nat) (value : Operand)
  | predRet (predicate : Nat) (when : Bool)
  | ret
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure State where
  core : PTX.State
  predicates : Nat → Bool
  halted : Bool

def next (s : State) : State := {s with core:=advance s.core}
def halt (s : State) : State := {next s with halted:=true}
def goto (s : State) (target : Nat) : State := {s with core:={s.core with pc:=target}}

def simple (ctx : Kernel.Context) (i : Instr) (s : State) : State :=
  match i with
  | .data _ => s
  | .context dst src => {s with core:=assign s.core dst (source ctx src)}
  | .compare dst cmp a b => {next s with predicates:=Function.update s.predicates dst (cmp.apply (a.eval s.core) (b.eval s.core))}
  | .branch p b target => if s.predicates p=b then goto s target else next s
  | .jump target => goto s target
  | .select p b dst value => if s.predicates p=b then {s with core:=assign s.core dst (value.eval s.core)} else next s
  | .predRet p b => if s.predicates p=b then halt s else next s
  | .ret => halt s

/-- Data access is the existing checked byte-memory semantics. Control steps
inspect actual registers and predicates; no branch outcome is supplied. -/
inductive Eval (ctx : Kernel.Context) : Instr → State → State → Prop where
  | data (step : Indexed.Eval op s.core t) : Eval ctx (.data op) s {s with core:=t}
  | simple (ordinary : ∀ op, i≠.data op) : Eval ctx i s (simple ctx i s)

def Step (ctx : Kernel.Context) (program : List Instr) (s t : State) : Prop :=
  s.halted=false ∧ ∃ i, program[s.core.pc]?=some i ∧ Eval ctx i s t

inductive Runs (ctx : Kernel.Context) (program : List Instr) : State → State → Prop where
  | nil : Runs ctx program s s
  | cons : Step ctx program s t → Runs ctx program t u → Runs ctx program s u

def eval (ctx : Kernel.Context) (i : Instr) (s : State) : Option State :=
  match i with
  | .data op => (Indexed.eval op s.core).map fun t => {s with core:=t}
  | _ => some (simple ctx i s)

def tick (ctx : Kernel.Context) (program : List Instr) (s : State) : Option State :=
  if s.halted then none else program[s.core.pc]? >>= fun i => eval ctx i s

/-- Fuel bounds a witness search, not the relational execution or correctness
statement. Running out of fuel cannot produce a successful returned state. -/
def execute (ctx : Kernel.Context) (program : List Instr) : Nat → State → Option State
  | 0,s => if s.halted then some s else none
  | fuel+1,s => if s.halted then some s else tick ctx program s >>= execute ctx program fuel

  cases i with
  | data op =>
    simp only [eval,Option.map_eq_some_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨u,step,rfl⟩ := h
    exact .data (Indexed.eval_sound step)
  | _ => cases h; apply Eval.simple; intro op h; cases h

theorem tick_sound (h : tick ctx program s=some t) : Step ctx program s t := by
  unfold tick at h

  · simp at h

    change (program[s.core.pc]?.bind fun i => eval ctx i s)=some t at h
    simp only [Option.bind_eq_some_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨i,fetch,step⟩ := h
    exact ⟨by cases h : s.halted <;> simp_all, i,fetch,eval_sound step⟩

  induction fuel generalizing s with

    simp only [execute] at h
    split at h

    · simp at h
  | succ fuel ih =>
    simp only [execute] at h
    split at h
    · cases h; exact ⟨.nil,by assumption⟩
    · change ((tick ctx program s).bind (execute ctx program fuel))=some t at h
      simp only [Option.bind_eq_some_iff] at h
      obtain ⟨mid,step,rest⟩ := h
      obtain ⟨run,done⟩ := ih rest
      exact ⟨.cons (tick_sound step) run,done⟩

  induction first with
  | nil => exact second
  | cons step rest ih => exact .cons step (ih second)

  intro step; have no := step.1; rw [h] at no; cases no

theorem invariant {P : State → Prop} (run : Runs ctx program s t) (initial : P s)
    (preserves : ∀ s t, Step ctx program s t → P s → P t) : P t := by
  induction run with
  | nil => exact initial
  | cons step rest ih => exact ih (preserves _ _ step initial)

/-- Cursor/end use registers 19/20; existing address, index, value and
accumulator registers retain their generated PTX meanings. -/
def lookupCode (entries element : Word) : List Indexed.Instr :=
  [.wide4 1 19,.data (.add64 2 (.reg 0) (.reg 1)),
   .data (.add64 2 (.reg 2) (.imm entries)),.load32 13 2,
   .data (.wide8 1 (.reg 13)),.data (.add64 2 (.reg 0) (.reg 1)),
   .data (.add64 2 (.reg 2) (.imm element)),.data (.load64 .global 4 (.reg 2))]

def indexAddress (s : State) (entries : Word) : Word := address32 (s.regs 0) (Kernel.u32 (s.regs 19)) entries
def index (s : State) (entries : Word) : BitVec 32 := read32 s.global (indexAddress s entries).toNat
def valueAddress (s : State) (entries element : Word) : Word := address64 (s.regs 0) (index s entries) element
def value (s : State) (entries element : Word) : Word := read64 s.global (valueAddress s entries element).toNat

def Valid (s : State) (entries element : Word) : Prop :=
  Valid32 s.globalStart s.globalBytes (indexAddress s entries).toNat ∧
  Valid64 s.globalStart s.globalBytes (valueAddress s entries element).toNat

def loaded (s : State) (entries element : Word) : State :=
  let r := Function.update s.regs 13 ((index s entries).setWidth 64)
  let r := Function.update r 1 (BitVec.ofNat 64 ((index s entries).toNat*8))
  let r := Function.update r 2 (valueAddress s entries element)
  let r := Function.update r 4 (value s entries element)

    Indexed.run (lookupCode entries element) s=some (loaded s entries element) := by
  obtain ⟨vi,vv⟩ := valid
  have low (v : BitVec 32) : v.toNat%4294967296=v.toNat := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt v.isLt
  have wide4 (x : Nat) : (x%4294967296*4)%18446744073709551616=x%4294967296*4 := by
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt; have := Nat.mod_lt x (by decide : 0<4294967296); omega
  have wide8 (x : Nat) : (x%4294967296*8)%18446744073709551616=x%4294967296*8 := by
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt; have := Nat.mod_lt x (by decide : 0<4294967296); omega
  simp [indexAddress,valueAddress,address32,address64,index,Kernel.u32,wide4,wide8,Nat.add_assoc] at vi vv
  simp [lookupCode,Indexed.run,Indexed.eval,Indexed.wide,PTX.eval,indexAddress,valueAddress,
    address32,address64,index,value,Kernel.u32,loaded,assign,advance,Operand.eval,State.start,
    State.bytes,State.memory,wide4,wide8,low,Nat.add_assoc,vi,vv]
  funext r
  by_cases one : r=1 <;> by_cases two : r=2 <;> simp [Function.update,one,two]

    (valid : Valid s entries element) : t=loaded s entries element := by
  have executed := Indexed.run_complete run (by simp [lookupCode,Indexed.noFP,PTX.noFP])
  rw [lookup_execution valid] at executed
  exact (Option.some.inj executed).symm

and advance the unsigned cursor. -/
def body (entries element : Word) : List Indexed.Instr := lookupCode entries element++[
  .data (.fp .add 8 (.reg 8) (.reg 4)),.data (.add32 19 (.reg 19) (.imm 1))]

  t.global=s.global ∧ t.shared=s.shared ∧ t.globalStart=s.globalStart ∧ t.globalBytes=s.globalBytes ∧
  t.sharedStart=s.sharedStart ∧ t.sharedBytes=s.sharedBytes ∧ t.regs 0=s.regs 0 ∧ t.regs 20=s.regs 20

/-- The two read-only arrays used by a node's contribution traversal.

  entryCount : Nat
  elementCount : Nat
  base : (s.regs 0).toNat=s.globalStart
  aligned : s.globalStart%8=0
  entriesAligned : entries.toNat%4=0
  elementAligned : element.toNat%8=0
  endBound : limit s≤entryCount
  small : entryCount<2^32
  entriesFit : entries.toNat+entryCount*4≤s.globalBytes
  elementFit : element.toNat+elementCount*8≤s.globalBytes
  noWrap : s.globalStart+s.globalBytes≤2^64
  indices : ∀ k<entryCount,
    (read32 s.global (s.globalStart+entries.toNat+k*4)).toNat<elementCount

    Valid (atCursor s k) entries element := by
  have entryBound : k<layout.entryCount := lt_of_lt_of_le inside layout.endBound
  have small : k<2^32 := lt_trans entryBound layout.small

  have current : Kernel.u32 ((atCursor s k).regs 19)=BitVec.ofNat 32 k := by
    simp [atCursor,Kernel.u32]
  have idxAddress : (indexAddress (atCursor s k) entries).toNat=s.globalStart+entries.toNat+k*4 := by
    unfold indexAddress
    rw [current]

    rw [address32_exact _ _ _ (by
      rw [layout.base,BitVec.toNat_ofNat,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt small]
      have := layout.entriesFit; have := layout.noWrap; omega)]
    rw [layout.base,BitVec.toNat_ofNat,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt small]

    unfold index; rw [idxAddress]; exact layout.indices k entryBound
  have valAddress : (valueAddress (atCursor s k) entries element).toNat=

    unfold valueAddress
    change (address64 (s.regs 0) (index (atCursor s k) entries) element).toNat=_
    rw [address64_exact _ _ _ (by
      rw [layout.base]; have := layout.elementFit; have := layout.noWrap; omega),layout.base]

def register : Nat → String
  | 19 => "%cursor"
  | 20 => "%end"
  | 21 => "%flag"
  | r => PTX.Text.register r

def operand : Operand → String
  | .reg r => register r
  | .imm w => toString w.toNat
  | .offset r w => s!"{register r}+{w.toNat}"

def data : Op → String
  | .mov dst src => s!"mov.b64 {register dst}, {operand src};"
  | .mul32 dst a b => s!"mul.lo.u32 {register dst}, {operand a}, {operand b};"
  | .add32 dst a b => s!"add.u32 {register dst}, {operand a}, {operand b};"
  | .add64 dst a b => s!"add.u64 {register dst}, {operand a}, {operand b};"
  | .wide8 dst i => s!"mul.wide.u32 {register dst}, {operand i}, 8;"
  | .load64 space dst addr => s!"ld.{PTX.Text.space space}.f64 {register dst}, [{operand addr}];"
  | .store64 space addr src => s!"st.{PTX.Text.space space}.f64 [{operand addr}], {operand src};"
  | .fp op dst a b => s!"{PTX.Text.operation op} {register dst}, {operand a}, {operand b};"

def indexed : Indexed.Instr → String
  | .data op => data op
  | .mad32 dst a scale b => s!"mad.lo.u32 {register dst}, {register a}, {scale.toNat}, {register b};"
  | .wide4 dst src => s!"mul.wide.u32 {register dst}, {register src}, 4;"
  | .load32 dst addr => s!"ld.global.u32 {register dst}, [{register addr}];"

def label (finish target : Nat) : String := if target=0 then "loop" else if target=finish then "done" else s!"pc_{target}"
def comparison : Flow.Compare → String | .ge => "ge" | .ne => "ne" | .lt => "lt"
def source : Flow.Source → String | .arena => "arena" | .lane => "%tid.x" | .group => "%ctaid.x"

  | .data op => indexed op
  | .context dst .arena => s!"ld.param.u64 {register dst}, [arena];"
  | .context dst src => s!"mov.u32 {register dst}, {source src};"
  | .compare p cmp a b => s!"setp.{comparison cmp}.u32 %p{p}, {operand a}, {operand b};"
  | .branch p yes target => s!"@{if yes then "" else "!"}%p{p} bra {label finish target};"
  | .jump target => s!"bra {label finish target};"
  | .select p yes dst value => s!"@{if yes then "" else "!"}%p{p} mov.b64 {register dst}, {operand value};"

def noFP : Instr → Bool | .data op => Indexed.noFP op | _ => true
def linear : Instr → Bool | .branch .. | .jump .. => false | _ => true

inductive Sequence (ctx : Kernel.Context) : List Instr → State → State → Prop where
  | nil : Sequence ctx [] s s
  | cons (running : s.halted=false) (step : Eval ctx i s middle) (rest : Sequence ctx code middle t) :
      Sequence ctx (i::code) s t

def sequence (ctx : Kernel.Context) : List Instr → State → Option State
  | [],s => some s
  | i::code,s => if s.halted then none else eval ctx i s >>= sequence ctx code

theorem sequence_sound (h : sequence ctx code s=some t) : Sequence ctx code s t := by
  induction code generalizing s with
  | nil => cases h; exact .nil
  | cons i code ih =>
    simp only [sequence] at h
    split at h
    · simp at h
    · rename_i running
      change ((eval ctx i s).bind (sequence ctx code))=some t at h
      obtain ⟨middle,first,rest⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp h
      exact .cons (by cases he : s.halted <;> simp_all) (eval_sound first) (ih rest)

theorem eval_complete (step : Eval ctx i s t) (plain : noFP i=true) : eval ctx i s=some t := by
  cases step with
  | data one => simp [eval,Indexed.eval_complete one plain]
  | simple ordinary => cases i <;> simp_all [eval]

theorem eval_unique (a : Eval ctx i s t) (b : Eval ctx i s u) (plain : noFP i=true) : t=u :=
  Option.some.inj ((eval_complete a plain).symm.trans (eval_complete b plain))

theorem linear_pc (step : Eval ctx i s t) (forward : linear i=true) : t.core.pc=s.core.pc+1 := by
  cases step with
  | data one => exact Indexed.eval_pc one
  | simple ordinary =>
    cases i <;> simp_all [linear,simple,next,halt,goto,assign,advance]
    all_goals split <;> rfl

    (pre post : List Instr) (pc : s.core.pc=pre.length) : Runs ctx (pre++code++post) s t := by
  induction trace generalizing pre with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | @cons i s middle code t running step rest ih =>
    apply Runs.cons (s:=s) (t:=middle) ⟨running,i,by simp [pc],step⟩
    have nextPC : middle.core.pc=(pre++[i]).length := by rw [linear_pc step (forward i (by simp)),pc]; simp
    simpa [List.append_assoc] using ih (fun j member => forward j (by simp [member])) (pre++[i]) nextPC

    obtain ⟨count,actual,number,one,last⟩ := peel run running done (i:=i) (by simp [pc])

def keeps (r : Nat) : Instr → Prop

  induction run with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | cons one rest ih => exact .cons (.data one) ih

/-- Each actual iteration consumes one remaining index; unsigned wrap is
excluded by the represented end index. No scheduling or numerical oracle is
needed for this single-thread, read-only loop fragment. -/
theorem window_exists (s : State) (frame : Stable initial s) (within : cursor s≤limit initial)
    (safe : ∀ k<limit initial, Valid (atCursor initial k) entries element) :
    ∃ t, Flow.Window.Traversal origin 19 20 (body entries element) s t := by
  have general : ∀ remaining s, limit initial-cursor s=remaining → Stable initial s →
      cursor s≤limit initial → ∃ t, Flow.Window.Traversal origin 19 20 (body entries element) s t := by
    intro remaining
    induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h remaining ih =>
      intro current amount stable bound
      by_cases last : cursor current=limit initial
      · refine ⟨{current with pc:=origin+(body entries element).length+3},.done ?_⟩
        change decide (limit current≤cursor current)=true
        simp [stable_limit stable,last]

        have insideCurrent : cursor current<limit current := by rw [stable_limit stable]; exact inside
        have valid : Valid {current with pc:=origin+2} entries element := valid_at stable (safe _ inside)
        obtain ⟨middle,step⟩ := body_exists {current with pc:=origin+2} valid
        have effect := body_correct step valid
        have increment : cursor middle=cursor current+1 := cursor_increment insideCurrent effect.2.1

/-- A padded thread returns at the entry guard. It does not read the offsets
or access the output, and does not require those addresses to be allocated. -/
theorem inactive_result
    (run : Flow.Runs ctx (entryCode count offsets entries element mask boundary output) s t)
    (pc : s.core.pc=0) (running : s.halted=false) (done : t.halted=true)
    (inactive : ¬Kernel.Residual.live ctx count) :
    t=setup ctx count s ∧ t.core.global=s.core.global := by
  obtain ⟨k,run⟩ := Flow.counted run
  have trace := Flow.sequence_sound (prologue_execution (s:=s) (ctx:=ctx) (count:=count) running)
  let post := (prepareCode offsets).map Flow.Instr.data++
    Flow.Window.header (entryPrefix count offsets).length 19 20 (body entries element)++
    (body entries element).map Flow.Instr.data++[.jump (entryPrefix count offsets).length]++tailCode mask boundary output
  obtain ⟨remaining,_,rest⟩ := Flow.consume_sequence trace
    (by simp [prologue,Flow.noFP,Indexed.noFP]) (by simp [prologue,Flow.linear])
    (pre:=[]) (post:=post) (by simpa [entryCode,Flow.Window.program,entryPrefix,post,List.append_assoc] using run) pc done

/-- The complete active entry has a returning execution for every safe ordered
contribution range. It includes the actual setup, loop, optional mask and store. -/
theorem entry_exists (s : Flow.State)
    (pc : s.core.pc=0) (running : s.halted=false) (live : Kernel.Residual.live ctx count)
    (prepareValid : PrepareValid (setup ctx count s).core offsets)
    (layout : Layout (ready ctx count offsets s).core entries element)
    (ordered : cursor (ready ctx count offsets s).core≤limit (ready ctx count offsets s).core)
    (maskValid : mask=true → Valid32 (ready ctx count offsets s).core.globalStart
      (ready ctx count offsets s).core.globalBytes (maskAddress (ready ctx count offsets s).core boundary).toNat)
    (outputValid : Valid64 (ready ctx count offsets s).core.globalStart (ready ctx count offsets s).core.globalBytes
      (address (ready ctx count offsets s).core 12 output).toNat) :
    ∃ t, Flow.Runs ctx (entryCode count offsets entries element mask boundary output) s t ∧ t.halted=true := by
  let start := ready ctx count offsets s
  obtain ⟨core,traverse⟩ := window_exists (origin:=(entryPrefix count offsets).length)
    start.core (stable_refl _) ordered (valid_of_layout layout)
  obtain ⟨middle,loopRun,same,alive⟩ := Flow.Window.traversal_runs
    (post:=tailCode mask boundary output) (ctx:=ctx) traverse start rfl
    (by simp [start,ready_pc,pc,entryPrefix,prologue,prepareCode]) (ready_running (s:=s) live)
  have trace : Flow.Window.Traversal (entryPrefix count offsets).length 19 20 (body entries element) start.core middle.core := by
    rw [same]; exact traverse
  have frame := (window_correct trace (stable_refl _) ordered (valid_of_layout layout)).2
  have node := window_node trace
  have outputAddress : address middle.core 12 output=address start.core 12 output := by
    simp only [address,wide,frame.2.2.2.2.2.2.1,node]
  have boundaryAddress : maskAddress middle.core boundary=maskAddress start.core boundary := by
    simp only [maskAddress,frame.2.2.2.2.2.2.1,node]
  have tail := tail_trace (ctx:=ctx) (s:=middle) (mask:=mask) (boundary:=boundary) (output:=output) alive
    (fun enabled => by simpa only [frame.2.2.1,frame.2.2.2.1,boundaryAddress] using maskValid enabled)
    (by simpa only [frame.2.2.1,frame.2.2.2.1,outputAddress] using outputValid)
  have tailRun : Flow.Runs ctx (entryCode count offsets entries element mask boundary output)
      middle (tailFinish ctx mask middle boundary output) := by
    simpa [entryCode,Flow.Window.program,beforeOutput,List.append_assoc] using
      Flow.sequence_run tail tail_linear (beforeOutput count offsets entries element) []
        (by have := Flow.Window.exit_pc trace; simpa [beforeOutput,Flow.Window.header,Nat.add_assoc] using this)
  have first : Flow.Runs ctx (entryCode count offsets entries element mask boundary output) s start := by
    have run := Flow.sequence_run (prefix_trace running live prepareValid) prefix_linear []
        (Flow.Window.header (entryPrefix count offsets).length 19 20 (body entries element)++
          (body entries element).map Flow.Instr.data++[.jump (entryPrefix count offsets).length]++tailCode mask boundary output) pc
    simpa [entryCode,Flow.Window.program,List.append_assoc,start] using run
  exact ⟨_,Flow.append first (Flow.append loopRun tailRun),tail_returned⟩

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Assembly.Text

/-- The emitted dialect writes zero as an f64 bit-pattern literal. Both mov
forms copy precisely the same 64 bits in the scalar semantics. -/
def fullInstruction (origin finish : Nat) : Flow.Instr → String
  | .data (.data (.mov 8 (.imm w))) => if w=0 then "mov.f64 %acc, 0d0000000000000000;" else instruction finish (.data (.data (.mov 8 (.imm w))))
  | .select 0 true 8 (.imm w) => if w=0 then "@%p0 mov.f64 %acc, 0d0000000000000000;" else instruction finish (.select 0 true 8 (.imm w))
  | .jump target => if target=origin then "bra loop;" else instruction finish (.jump target)
  | op => instruction finish op

/-- Labels are inserted at positions computed from the same instruction lists
used by the whole-entry execution theorems. -/
def fullRendered (count : BitVec 32) (offsets entries element : Word) (mask : Bool) (boundary output : Word) : List String :=
  let origin := (entryPrefix count offsets).length
  let finish := (beforeOutput count offsets entries element).length
  (entryCode count offsets entries element mask boundary output).zipIdx.flatMap fun (op,pc) =>
    (if pc=origin then ["loop:"] else if pc=finish then ["done:"] else [])++[fullInstruction origin finish op]

def fullShape (count : BitVec 32) (offsets entries element : Word) (mask : Bool) (boundary output : Word) :
    Nat × List (Nat × Nat) :=
  let code := entryCode count offsets entries element mask boundary output
  (code.length,code.zipIdx.filterMap fun (op,pc) => match op with
    | .branch _ _ target | .jump target => some (pc,target) | _ => none)
