/-- Storage and launch geometry. The size bound matches the emitted host
layout and prevents wrap in node indexing and the next-offset calculation. -/
structure Arena (nodes : Nat) where
  (base offsets entries element boundary output : Word)
  (bytes entryCount elementCount : Nat)
  small : nodes<2^30
  entriesSmall : entryCount<2^32
  aligned : base.toNat%8=0
  noWrap : base.toNat+bytes≤2^64
  offsetAligned : offsets.toNat%4=0
  entryAligned : entries.toNat%4=0
  elementAligned : element.toNat%8=0
  boundaryAligned : boundary.toNat%4=0
  outputAligned : output.toNat%8=0
  offsetsFit : offsets.toNat+(nodes+1)*4≤bytes
  entriesFit : entries.toNat+entryCount*4≤bytes
  elementFit : element.toNat+elementCount*8≤bytes
  boundaryFit : boundary.toNat+nodes*4≤bytes
  outputFit : output.toNat+nodes*8≤bytes

def Arena.context (a : Arena n) (i : Fin n) : Kernel.Context :=
  ⟨a.base,BitVec.ofNat 32 (i.val%256),BitVec.ofNat 32 (i.val/256)⟩

theorem Arena.output_address (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (regs : Registers) (i : Fin n) :
    (address (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core 12 a.output).toNat=
      a.base.toNat+a.output.toNat+i.val*8 := by
  have eq : address (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core 12 a.output=
      address64 a.base (Kernel.Residual.index (a.context i)) a.output := by
    simp [address,wide,ready,prepared,setup,address64,BitVec.toNat_setWidth,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Kernel.Residual.index (a.context i)).isLt]
    rfl
  rw [eq,address64_exact _ _ _ (by rw [a.index]; have := a.outputFit; have := a.noWrap; have := i.isLt; omega),a.index]
  omega

theorem Arena.boundary_address (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (regs : Registers) (i : Fin n) :
    (maskAddress (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core a.boundary).toNat=
      a.base.toNat+a.boundary.toNat+i.val*4 := by
  have eq : maskAddress (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core a.boundary=

    simp [maskAddress,ready,prepared,setup,Arena.context,Kernel.u32]
  rw [eq,address32_exact _ _ _ (by rw [a.index]; have := a.boundaryFit; have := a.noWrap; have := i.isLt; omega),a.index]
  omega

    Valid64 (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core.globalStart
      (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core.globalBytes
      (address (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core 12 a.output).toNat := by

  change Valid64 a.base.toNat a.bytes _

    Valid32 (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core.globalStart
      (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core.globalBytes

  omega

def Arena.entryIndex (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (k : Nat) : Nat :=
  (read32 memory (a.base.toNat+a.entries.toNat+k*4)).toNat

def Arena.elementValue (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (k : Nat) : Float :=
  decode (read64 memory (a.base.toNat+a.element.toNat+k*8))

def Arena.row (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (i : Fin n) : List Nat :=
  (List.range' (a.offset memory i.val) (a.offset memory (i.val+1)-a.offset memory i.val)).map (a.entryIndex memory)

def Arena.value (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (i : Fin n) (mask : Bool) : Float :=
  if mask=true ∧ read32 memory (a.base.toNat+a.boundary.toNat+i.val*4)≠0 then 0 else
    (a.row memory i).foldl (fun acc k => acc+a.elementValue memory k) 0

theorem Arena.contribution_value (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (regs : Registers) (i : Fin n)
    (contents : a.Contents memory) (k : Nat) (inside : k<a.entryCount) :
    contribution (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core a.entries a.element k=
      a.elementValue memory (a.entryIndex memory k) := by
  let initial := (ready (a.context i) (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets (a.start memory regs)).core
  have small : k<2^32 := lt_trans inside a.entriesSmall
  have current : Kernel.u32 ((atCursor initial k).regs 19)=BitVec.ofNat 32 k := by simp [atCursor,Kernel.u32]
  have base : initial.regs 0=a.base := by simp [initial,ready,prepared,setup,Arena.context]
  have mem : initial.global=memory := rfl
  have idxAddress : (indexAddress (atCursor initial k) a.entries).toNat=a.base.toNat+a.entries.toNat+k*4 := by
    unfold indexAddress
    rw [current]
    change (address32 (initial.regs 0) (BitVec.ofNat 32 k) a.entries).toNat=_
    rw [base,address32_exact _ _ _ (by
      rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt small]
      have := a.entriesFit; have := a.noWrap; omega)]
    rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt small]
    omega
  have idx : (Assembly.index (atCursor initial k) a.entries).toNat=a.entryIndex memory k := by
    change (read32 initial.global (indexAddress (atCursor initial k) a.entries).toNat).toNat=_
    rw [idxAddress,mem]
    rfl
  have bound := contents.indices k inside
  change a.entryIndex memory k<a.elementCount at bound
  have valAddress : (valueAddress (atCursor initial k) a.entries a.element).toNat=
      a.base.toNat+a.element.toNat+(a.entryIndex memory k)*8 := by
    unfold valueAddress
    change (address64 (initial.regs 0) (Assembly.index (atCursor initial k) a.entries) a.element).toNat=_
    rw [base,address64_exact _ _ _ (by rw [idx]; have := a.elementFit; have := a.noWrap; omega),idx]
    omega

  rw [valAddress,mem]
  rfl

    have fold {f g : Nat → Float} : ∀ (xs : List Nat) (acc : Float),

      induction xs with

/-- Each pair names a mesh node and its position in the flat cell-value array.
Filtering preserves the element-major and row-major order of this input list. -/
def selected (locations : List (Nat × Nat)) (node : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (locations.filter fun item => item.1==node).map Prod.snd

def contributions (locations : List (Nat × Nat)) (values : Nat → Float) : List (Nat × Float) :=
  locations.map fun item => (item.1,values item.2)

/-- Filtering cells into one node's index list preserves precisely the ordered
scatter sum. No associativity, commutativity or reassociation is used. -/
theorem ordered (locations : List (Nat × Nat)) (values : Nat → Float) (node : Nat) :
    (selected locations node).foldl (fun acc k => acc+values k) 0=
      (contributions locations values).foldl Correspondence.scatterStep (fun _ => 0) node := by
  rw [Correspondence.scatter_gather]
  have general : ∀ (xs : List (Nat × Nat)) (acc : Float),
      (selected xs node).foldl (fun acc k => acc+values k) acc=
        ((contributions xs values).filter fun item => item.1==node).foldl (fun acc item => acc+item.2) acc := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil => intro acc; rfl
    | cons item rest ih =>
      intro acc
      by_cases same : item.1=node
      · simpa [selected,contributions,same] using ih (acc+values item.2)
      · simpa [selected,contributions,same] using ih acc

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Assembly.Snapshot

/-- Completed fetched executions against one initial snapshot. A separate
source-admission argument must justify this view for concurrent executions. -/
structure Finished (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (mask : Bool) where
  regs : Fin n → Registers
  final : Fin n → Flow.State
  run : ∀ i, Flow.Runs (a.context i)
    (entryCode (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets a.entries a.element mask a.boundary a.output)
    (a.start memory (regs i)) (final i)
  done : ∀ i, (final i).halted=true

variable {n : Nat} {a : Arena n} {memory : Memory} {mask : Bool} {i : Fin n}

def address (a : Arena n) (i : Fin n) : Nat := a.base.toNat+a.output.toNat+i.val*8

def word (c : Finished a memory mask) (i : Fin n) : Word :=
  read64 (c.final i).core.global (address a i)

theorem written (c : Finished a memory mask) (contents : a.Contents memory) (i : Fin n) :
    (c.final i).core.global=write64 memory (address a i) (word c i) ∧
      decode (word c i)=a.value memory i mask := by
  obtain ⟨stored,effect,value⟩ := a.complete memory (c.regs i) i contents mask (c.run i) (c.done i)
  have same : word c i=stored := by simp [word,address,effect]
  rw [a.value_eq memory (c.regs i) i contents mask] at value
  exact ⟨by rw [same]; exact effect,by rw [same]; exact value⟩

/-- Mathematical publication of the one actual output word per completed
thread. This does not assert CUDA visibility or concurrent source validity. -/
def publish (c : Finished a memory mask) : List (Fin n) → Memory
  | [] => memory
  | i::rest => write64 (publish c rest) (address a i) (word c i)

theorem published_word (c : Finished a memory mask) (order : List (Fin n)) (included : i∈order) :
    read64 (publish c order) (address a i)=word c i := by
  induction order with
  | nil => simp at included
  | cons j rest ih =>
    by_cases same : j=i
    · subst j; simp [publish]
    · have keep := read64_write64_disjoint (publish c rest) (address a j) (address a i) (word c j) (a.owners j i same)
      exact keep.trans (ih ((List.mem_cons.mp included).resolve_left (Ne.symm same)))

theorem published_value (c : Finished a memory mask) (contents : a.Contents memory)
    (order : List (Fin n)) (complete : ∀ i, i∈order) (i : Fin n) :
    decode (read64 (publish c order) (address a i))=a.value memory i mask := by
  rw [published_word c order (complete i)]
  exact (written c contents i).2

theorem published_outside (c : Finished a memory mask) (order : List (Fin n)) (p : Nat)
    (outside : ∀ i, p<address a i ∨ address a i+8≤p) : publish c order p=memory p := by
  induction order with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i rest ih => rw [publish,write64_outside _ _ _ _ (outside i),ih]

/-- Existence is obtained from returning instruction executions, independently
of the universal publication result. -/
noncomputable def witness (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (contents : a.Contents memory)
    (regs : Fin n → Registers) (mask : Bool) : Finished a memory mask where
  regs := regs
  final := fun i => Classical.choose (a.exists memory (regs i) i contents mask)
  run := fun i => (Classical.choose_spec (a.exists memory (regs i) i contents mask)).1
  done := fun i => (Classical.choose_spec (a.exists memory (regs i) i contents mask)).2

/-- The representation premise specifies the ordered input index list. It
contains no output sum. Cell-value correspondence can instantiate values from
a previously proved publication of the element kernel. -/
theorem scatter (c : Finished a memory mask) (contents : a.Contents memory)
    (locations : List (Nat × Nat))
    (represented : ∀ i, a.row memory i=Rows.selected locations i.val)
    (order : List (Fin n)) (complete : ∀ i, i∈order) (i : Fin n) :
    decode (read64 (publish c order) (address a i))=
      if mask=true ∧ read32 memory (a.base.toNat+a.boundary.toNat+i.val*4)≠0 then 0 else
        (Rows.contributions locations (a.elementValue memory)).foldl Correspondence.scatterStep (fun _ => 0) i.val := by
  rw [published_value c contents order complete i]
  unfold Arena.value
  rw [represented i,Rows.ordered]

def arena : Arena 2 where
  base := 4096
  offsets := 64
  entries := 0
  element := 32
  boundary := 80
  output := 96
  bytes := 112
  entryCount := 3
  elementCount := 3
  small := by decide
  entriesSmall := by decide
  aligned := by decide
  noWrap := by decide
  offsetAligned := by decide
  entryAligned := by decide
  elementAligned := by decide
  boundaryAligned := by decide
  outputAligned := by decide
  offsetsFit := by decide
  entriesFit := by decide
  elementFit := by decide
  boundaryFit := by decide
  outputFit := by decide

/-- Two nodes, three values and a nonzero arena base. The second node is a
boundary node, so the masked entry must replace its sum with zero. -/
def memory : Memory :=
  write32 (write32 (write32 (write32 (write32
    (write64 (write64 (write64
      (write32 (write32 (write32 (fun _ => 0) 4096 0) 4100 1) 4104 2)
      4128 0x4000000000000000) 4136 0x4008000000000000) 4144 0x4010000000000000)
    4160 0) 4164 2) 4168 3) 4176 0) 4180 1

def contents : arena.Contents memory := by
  constructor
  · intro i hi; interval_cases i <;> decide +kernel
  · intro i hi; interval_cases i <;> decide +kernel
  · intro k hk; change k<3 at hk; interval_cases k <;> decide +kernel

def candidate (mask : Bool) (i : Fin 2) := Flow.execute (arena.context i)
  (entryCode 2 64 0 32 mask 80 96) 70 (arena.start memory (fun _ => 0))

def result (mask : Bool) (i : Fin 2) := (candidate mask i).getD (arena.start memory (fun _ => 0))

theorem executed (mask : Bool) (i : Fin 2) : candidate mask i=some (result mask i) := by
  have yes : (candidate mask i).isSome=true := by cases mask <;> fin_cases i <;> decide +kernel
  cases h : candidate mask i with
  | none => simp [h] at yes
  | some out => simp [result,h]

def finished (mask : Bool) : Snapshot.Finished arena memory mask where
  regs := fun _ _ => 0
  final := result mask
  run := fun i => (Flow.execute_sound (executed mask i)).1
  done := fun i => (Flow.execute_sound (executed mask i)).2

theorem row_order (i : Fin 2) : arena.row memory i=Rows.selected [(0,0),(0,1),(1,2)] i.val := by
  fin_cases i <;> decide +kernel

theorem values : arena.value memory 0 false=5 ∧ arena.value memory 1 false=4 ∧

    decode (read64 (Snapshot.publish (finished mask) (if reverse then [1,0] else [0,1]))

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Flow.Observed

/-- Fetched control flow with explicit records for arbitrary candidate load
bits. Source admission is separate, including four-byte index observations. -/
inductive Eval (ctx : Kernel.Context) : Instr → State → State →
    Option Concurrent.Access → Option IndexSources.Access → Prop where
  | data (step : Indexed.Candidate.Data op s.core t access index) :
      Eval ctx (.data op) s {s with core:=t} access index
  | simple (ordinary : ∀ op, i≠.data op) : Eval ctx i s (simple ctx i s) none none

def Step (ctx : Kernel.Context) (program : List Instr) (s t : State)
    (access : Option Concurrent.Access) (index : Option IndexSources.Access) : Prop :=
  s.halted=false ∧ ∃ i, program[s.core.pc]?=some i ∧ Eval ctx i s t access index

inductive Runs (ctx : Kernel.Context) (program : List Instr) : State →
    List Concurrent.Access → List IndexSources.Access → State → Prop where
  | nil : Runs ctx program s [] [] s
  | cons : Step ctx program s t access index → Runs ctx program t words indices u →
      Runs ctx program s (access.toList++words) (index.toList++indices) u

/-- Once a candidate step's read bits are justified against its actual local
memory, it is a step of the existing relational instruction semantics. -/
theorem replay_step (step : Step ctx program s t access index)
    (words : ∀ a, access=some a → a.data.store=false →
      a.data.value=read64 (s.core.memory a.space) a.data.address)
    (indices : ∀ a, index=some a → a.value=read32 s.core.global a.address) :
    Flow.Step ctx program s t := by
  obtain ⟨running,i,fetch,execution⟩ := step
  refine ⟨running,i,fetch,?_⟩
  cases execution with
  | data one => exact .data (Indexed.Candidate.replay one words indices)
  | simple ordinary => exact .simple ordinary

theorem append (first : Runs ctx program s wa ia t) (second : Runs ctx program t wb ib u) :
    Runs ctx program s (wa++wb) (ia++ib) u := by
  induction first with
  | nil => exact second
  | cons step rest ih => simpa only [List.append_assoc] using Runs.cons step (ih second)

/-- Every recorded store comes from the corresponding fetched store opcode;
its address and bits are the operands of that actual pre-instruction state. -/
theorem store_shape (execution : Eval ctx op s t (some a) index) (store : a.data.store=true) :
    ∃ sp addr src, op=.data (.data (.store64 sp addr src)) ∧
      a=⟨sp,⟨s.core.pc,true,(addr.eval s.core).toNat,src.eval s.core⟩⟩ := by
  cases execution with
  | data one =>
    cases one with
    | data one =>
      cases one with
      | load => simp at store
      | store => exact ⟨_,_,_,rfl,rfl⟩

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Flow.Observed

/-- The local byte memory still agrees with the initial snapshot at every
recorded read. This is an invariant proved across disjoint stores. -/
def ReadFrame (initial : Space → Memory) (words : List Concurrent.Access)
    (indices : List IndexSources.Access) (s : PTX.State) : Prop :=
  (∀ a∈words, a.data.store=false → read64 (s.memory a.space) a.data.address=read64 (initial a.space) a.data.address) ∧
  (∀ a∈indices, read32 s.global a.address=read32 (initial .global) a.address)

/-- Physical separation of actual recorded accesses, rather than an assumption
about which numerical result a load is supposed to return. -/
def Separate (words : List Concurrent.Access) (indices : List IndexSources.Access) : Prop :=
  (∀ w∈words, w.data.store=true → ∀ r∈words, r.data.store=false → w.space=r.space →
    w.data.address+8≤r.data.address ∨ r.data.address+8≤w.data.address) ∧
  (∀ w∈words, w.data.store=true → w.space=.global → ∀ r∈indices,
    w.data.address+8≤r.address ∨ r.address+4≤w.data.address)

theorem put_frame {address : Nat} {sp : Space} {value : Word} (frame : ReadFrame initial words indices s)
    (wordApart : ∀ a∈words, a.data.store=false → sp=a.space → address+8≤a.data.address ∨ a.data.address+8≤address)

    · exact old

  · intro a member

  | wide4 => exact frame

    (recorded : ∀ a, access=some a → a∈words) : ReadFrame initial words indices t.core := by
  obtain ⟨_,_,_,execution⟩ := step
  cases execution with

  | simple => exact simple_frame frame

/-- Justified candidate read bits and disjoint writes recover the complete
snapshot execution, including loops and its actual stores. -/
theorem replay (run : Runs ctx program s words indices t)
    (wordValues : ∀ a∈words, a.data.store=false → a.data.value=read64 (initial a.space) a.data.address)
    (indexValues : ∀ a∈indices, a.value=read32 (initial .global) a.address)
    (apart : Separate words indices) (frame : ReadFrame initial words indices s.core) :
    Flow.Runs ctx program s t := by
  induction run with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | @cons s middle access index words indices t step rest ih =>
    have recorded : ∀ a, access=some a → a∈access.toList++words := by intro a eq; simp [eq]
    have recordedIndex : ∀ a, index=some a → a∈index.toList++indices := by intro a eq; simp [eq]
    have one := replay_step step
      (fun a eq read => (wordValues a (recorded a eq) read).trans (frame.1 a (recorded a eq) read).symm)
      (fun a eq => (indexValues a (recordedIndex a eq)).trans (frame.2 a (recordedIndex a eq)).symm)
    have nextFrame := step_frame step frame apart recorded
    refine .cons one (ih ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_)
    · intro a member; exact wordValues a (List.mem_append_right _ member)
    · intro a member; exact indexValues a (List.mem_append_right _ member)
    · constructor
      · intro w member store r observed read same
        exact apart.1 w (List.mem_append_right _ member) store r (List.mem_append_right _ observed) read same
      · intro w member store global r observed
        exact apart.2 w (List.mem_append_right _ member) store global r (List.mem_append_right _ observed)

/-- Recording actual accesses loses no ordinary scalar execution. The load
records use its actual memory bits, including permitted result encodings. -/
theorem data_exists (step : Indexed.Eval op s t) :
    ∃ access index, Indexed.Candidate.Data op s t access index := by
  cases step with
  | data one =>
    cases one with
    | load64 valid => exact ⟨_,_,.data (.load valid)⟩
    | store64 valid => exact ⟨_,_,.data (.store valid)⟩
    | _ => exact ⟨none,none,.data (.ordinary rfl (by constructor <;> assumption))⟩
  | mad32 => exact ⟨none,none,.mad32⟩
  | wide4 => exact ⟨none,none,.wide4⟩
  | load32 valid => exact ⟨none,_,.load32 valid⟩

theorem eval_exists (step : Flow.Eval ctx op s t) : ∃ access index, Eval ctx op s t access index := by
  cases step with
  | data one => obtain ⟨a,i,step⟩ := data_exists one; exact ⟨a,i,.data step⟩
  | simple ordinary => exact ⟨none,none,.simple ordinary⟩

theorem run_exists (run : Flow.Runs ctx program s t) :
    ∃ words indices, Runs ctx program s words indices t := by
  induction run with
  | nil => exact ⟨[],[],.nil⟩
  | @cons s middle t step rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨running,op,fetch,one⟩ := step
    obtain ⟨access,index,execution⟩ := eval_exists one
    obtain ⟨words,indices,tail⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨_,_,.cons ⟨running,op,fetch,execution⟩ tail⟩

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Flow.Parallel

/-- A launch may interleave any running thread. This fragment has no barriers;
its load choices are constrained separately by the recorded byte sources. -/
inductive Runs (ctx : Fin n → Kernel.Context) (program : List Instr) :
    (Fin n → State) → List (Concurrent.Event n) → List (Fin n × IndexSources.Access) → (Fin n → State) → Prop where
  | nil : Runs ctx program s [] [] s
  | cons (step : Observed.Step (ctx thread) program (s thread) t access index)
      (rest : Runs ctx program (Function.update s thread t) words indices u) :
      Runs ctx program s (access.toList.map (Concurrent.Event.data thread)++words)
        (index.toList.map (thread,·)++indices) u

def wordsFor (thread : Fin n) (events : List (Concurrent.Event n)) : List Concurrent.Access :=
  events.filterMap fun event => match event with
    | .data owner a => if owner=thread then some a else none
    | .barrier _ => none

def indicesFor (thread : Fin n) (indices : List (Fin n × IndexSources.Access)) : List IndexSources.Access :=
  indices.filterMap fun (owner,a) => if owner=thread then some a else none

variable {n : Nat} {ctx : Fin n → Kernel.Context} {s t : Fin n → State}
  {words : List (Concurrent.Event n)} {indices : List (Fin n × IndexSources.Access)}

/-- Project a thread from an actual arbitrary interleaving. Its control flow
and all of its observed loads/stores are retained. -/
theorem project (run : Runs ctx program s words indices t) (thread : Fin n) :
    Observed.Runs (ctx thread) program (s thread) (wordsFor thread words) (indicesFor thread indices) (t thread) := by
  induction run with
  | nil => exact .nil
  | @cons selected s middle access index words indices t step rest ih =>
    by_cases same : selected=thread
    · subst selected
      simp only [Function.update_self] at ih
      have one := Observed.Runs.cons step ih
      simpa [wordsFor,indicesFor,List.filterMap_append] using one
    · simpa [wordsFor,indicesFor,List.filterMap_append,Function.update,same,Ne.symm same] using ih

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Flow.Parallel
variable {n : Nat} {ctx : Fin n → Kernel.Context} {s t : Fin n → State}
  {words : List (Concurrent.Event n)} {indices : List (Fin n × IndexSources.Access)}

theorem word_member : a∈wordsFor thread words ↔ Concurrent.Event.data thread a∈words := by
  simp only [wordsFor,List.mem_filterMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨event,member,selected⟩
    cases event with
    | barrier => simp at selected
    | data owner observed =>
      by_cases same : owner=thread
      · simp [same] at selected
        subst observed
        simpa [same] using member
      · simp [same] at selected
  · intro member
    exact ⟨_,member,by simp⟩

theorem index_member : a∈indicesFor thread indices ↔ (thread,a)∈indices := by
  simp only [indicesFor,List.mem_filterMap]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨owner,observed⟩,member,selected⟩
    by_cases same : owner=thread
    · simp [same] at selected
      subst observed
      simpa [same] using member
    · simp [same] at selected
  · intro member; exact ⟨_,member,by simp⟩

/-- Every pair is about recorded accesses in the whole launch. This permits
all schedules while making the physical non-aliasing obligation explicit. -/
def Separate (words : List (Concurrent.Event n)) (indices : List (Fin n × IndexSources.Access)) : Prop :=
  (∀ writer w, Concurrent.Event.data writer w∈words → w.data.store=true →
    ∀ reader r, Concurrent.Event.data reader r∈words → r.data.store=false → w.space=r.space →
      w.data.address+8≤r.data.address ∨ r.data.address+8≤w.data.address) ∧
  (∀ writer w, Concurrent.Event.data writer w∈words → w.data.store=true → w.space=.global →
    ∀ reader r, (reader,r)∈indices → w.data.address+8≤r.address ∨ r.address+4≤w.data.address)

theorem values (compatible : Concurrent.Visibility.Compatible initial words wordSource)
    (indexCompatible : IndexSources.Compatible (initial .global) words indices indexSource)
    (apart : Separate words indices) (thread : Fin n) :
    (∀ a∈wordsFor thread words, a.data.store=false → a.data.value=read64 (initial a.space) a.data.address) ∧
    (∀ a∈indicesFor thread indices, a.value=read32 (initial .global) a.address) := by
  constructor
  · intro a member read
    have member := word_member.mp member
    obtain ⟨r,located⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem?.mp member
    apply Concurrent.Visibility.read_only_value compatible located read
    intro w writer wa fetched store same j k
    have disjoint := apart.1 writer wa (List.mem_of_getElem? fetched) store thread a member read same
    have := j.isLt; have := k.isLt; omega
  · intro a member
    have member := index_member.mp member
    obtain ⟨r,located⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem?.mp member
    apply IndexSources.read_only_value indexCompatible located
    intro w writer wa fetched store global j k
    have disjoint := apart.2 writer wa (List.mem_of_getElem? fetched) store global thread a member
    have := j.isLt; have := k.isLt; omega

/-- Derive each complete local execution from actual launch interleaving and
byte-source constraints. No local execution or desired read value is supplied. -/
theorem replay (run : Runs ctx program s words indices t)
    (compatible : Concurrent.Visibility.Compatible initial words wordSource)
    (indexCompatible : IndexSources.Compatible (initial .global) words indices indexSource)
    (apart : Separate words indices) (memory : ∀ i, (s i).core.memory=initial) (thread : Fin n) :
    Flow.Runs (ctx thread) program (s thread) (t thread) := by
  have calculated := values compatible indexCompatible apart thread
  apply Observed.replay (project run thread) calculated.1 calculated.2
  · constructor
    · intro w stored store r readmem read same
      exact apart.1 thread w (word_member.mp stored) store thread r (word_member.mp readmem) read same
    · intro w stored store global r readmem
      exact apart.2 thread w (word_member.mp stored) store global thread r (index_member.mp readmem)
  · constructor
    · intro a _ _; rw [memory thread]
    · intro a _
      have global := congrFun (memory thread) Space.global
      change (s thread).core.global=initial .global at global
      rw [global]

and arithmetic accumulators remain unrestricted. -/
def Ready (ctx : Kernel.Context) (mask : Bool) (output : Word) (s : Flow.State) : Prop :=
  let cut := if mask then 35 else 29
  (1≤s.core.pc → s.core.regs 0=ctx.arena) ∧
  (2≤s.core.pc → s.core.regs 14=ctx.lane.setWidth 64) ∧
  (3≤s.core.pc → s.core.regs 15=ctx.group.setWidth 64) ∧
  (4≤s.core.pc → s.core.regs 12=(Kernel.Residual.index ctx).setWidth 64) ∧
  (s.core.pc=cut+1 → s.core.regs 1=wide s.core 12) ∧
  (s.core.pc=cut+2 → s.core.regs 2=s.core.regs 0+wide s.core 12) ∧
  (s.core.pc=cut+3 → s.core.regs 2=address s.core 12 output)

  cases mask <;> simp [Ready,pc]

    (ready : Ready ctx mask output s) : Ready ctx mask output t := by
  obtain ⟨running,op,fetch,execution⟩ := step

      List.length_append,List.length_map,List.length_cons,List.length_nil,ite_true,ite_false,Bool.false_eq_true] at bound

  all_goals simp only [entryCode,Flow.Window.program,entryPrefix,prologue,prepareCode,Flow.Window.header,
    body,lookupCode,tailCode,maskCode,maskLoad,outputCode,storeCode,addressCode,pc,
    List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.cons_append,List.nil_append,

      body,lookupCode,tailCode,maskCode,maskLoad,outputCode,storeCode,addressCode,
      List.length_append,List.length_map,List.length_cons,List.length_nil,ite_true,ite_false,Bool.false_eq_true] at bound

namespace PtxTorchLean.Poisson.PTX.Assembly
variable {n : Nat} {contexts : Fin n → Kernel.Context} {s t : Fin n → Flow.State}
  {words : List (Concurrent.Event n)} {indices : List (Fin n × IndexSources.Access)}

/-- All recorded stores in any interleaving have their owner's actual output
address. Neither source compatibility nor read values are needed for this. -/
theorem parallel_stores (run : Flow.Parallel.Runs contexts
    (entryCode count offsets entries element mask boundary output) s words indices t)
    (pc : ∀ thread, (s thread).core.pc=0)
    (member : Concurrent.Event.data thread access∈words) (store : access.data.store=true) :
    access.space=.global ∧ access.data.address=(address64 (contexts thread).arena (Kernel.Residual.index (contexts thread)) output).toNat :=
  ObservedAddress.stores (Flow.Parallel.project run thread) (ObservedAddress.initial (pc thread)) access
    (Flow.Parallel.word_member.mpr member) store

/-- For the physical active-lane launch, recorded store ownership reduces to
nonwrapping, disjoint eight-byte node slots. -/
theorem Arena.parallel_store (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (regs : Fin n → Registers)
    (run : Flow.Parallel.Runs a.context
      (entryCode (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets a.entries a.element mask a.boundary a.output)
      (fun i => a.start memory (regs i)) words indices t)
    (member : Concurrent.Event.data thread access∈words) (store : access.data.store=true) :
    access.space=.global ∧ access.data.address=a.base.toNat+a.output.toNat+thread.val*8 := by
  obtain ⟨global,address⟩ := parallel_stores run (fun _ => rfl) member store
  constructor
  · exact global
  · rw [address]
    change (address64 a.base (Kernel.Residual.index (a.context thread)) a.output).toNat=_
    rw [address64_exact _ _ _ (by rw [a.index]; have := a.outputFit; have := a.noWrap; have := thread.isLt; omega),a.index]
    omega

/-- Distinct threads' actual writes are disjoint independently of candidate
load bits, instruction interleaving and floating-point output encodings. -/
theorem Arena.parallel_owners (a : Arena n) (memory : Memory) (regs : Fin n → Registers)
    (run : Flow.Parallel.Runs a.context
      (entryCode (BitVec.ofNat 32 n) a.offsets a.entries a.element mask a.boundary a.output)
      (fun i => a.start memory (regs i)) words indices t)
    (left : Concurrent.Event.data i one∈words) (leftStore : one.data.store=true)
    (right : Concurrent.Event.data j two∈words) (rightStore : two.data.store=true) (different : i≠j) :
    Sources.Disjoint one.data.address two.data.address := by
  rw [(a.parallel_store memory regs run left leftStore).2,(a.parallel_store memory regs run right rightStore).2]
  exact a.owners i j different

    (∀ a b left right la ra, events[a]?=some (.data left la) → events[b]?=some (.data right ra) →
      la.data.store=true → ra.data.store=true → la.space=.shared → ra.space=.shared →
      Before events a b → ∀ j k : Fin 8, la.data.address+j.val=ra.data.address+k.val → coherence a b) ∧
    (∀ r w reader writer ra wa, events[r]?=some (.data reader ra) → events[w]?=some (.data writer wa) →
      ra.data.store=false → wa.data.store=true → ra.space=.shared → wa.space=.shared →
      Before events r w → ∀ j k : Fin 8, wa.data.address+j.val=ra.data.address+k.val → source r k≠.store w j) ∧
    (∀ w r writer reader wa ra, events[w]?=some (.data writer wa) → events[r]?=some (.data reader ra) →
      wa.data.store=true → ra.data.store=false → wa.space=.shared → ra.space=.shared →
      Before events w r → ∀ j k : Fin 8, wa.data.address+j.val=ra.data.address+k.val →
      match source r k with | .initial => False | .store old _ => ¬coherence old w)

rules explicitly and implies the earlier Performed condition. Actual small
fetched executions show the difference: a read between writes of seven and
nine can select either an older three or the future nine under the earlier
constraints, while the new rules reject both and admit seven. A universal

theorem read_from_stage (compatible : Compatible initial events source)
    (admitted : OrderedSources events source)
    (hw : events[w]?=some (.data writer wa)) (hr : events[r]?=some (.data reader ra))
    (write : wa.data.store=true) (read : ra.data.store=false)
    (sw : wa.space=.shared) (sr : ra.space=.shared)
    (same : wa.data.address=ra.data.address) (before : Before events w r)
    (around : WritersAround events w r ra.data.address) :
    ra.data.value=wa.data.value ∧ ∀ k, source r k=.store w k := by
  obtain ⟨coherence,ordered,future,stale⟩ := admitted.ordered
  have chosen : ∀ k, source r k=.store w k ∧ byte ra.data.value k.val=byte wa.data.value k.val := by
    intro k
    have h := compatible r reader ra hr read k
    have recent := stale w r writer reader wa ra hw hr write read sw sr before k k (by rw [same])
    cases hs : source r k with
    | initial => simpa [hs] using recent
    | store other j =>
      simp only [hs] at h recent
      obtain ⟨thread,access,found,store,space,address,value⟩ := h
      have shared := space.trans sr
      rcases around other thread access found store shared j k address with own | earlier | later
      · subst other
        have eq : access=wa := by have e := Option.some.inj (found.symm.trans hw); cases e; rfl
        subst access
        have jk : j=k := by apply Fin.ext; omega
        subst j
        exact ⟨rfl,value⟩
      · exact False.elim (recent (ordered other w thread writer access wa found hw store write shared sw earlier
          j k (by simpa [same] using address)))
      · exact False.elim (future r other reader thread ra access hr found read store sr shared later j k address hs)
  exact ⟨Sources.word_eq_of_bytes _ _ (fun k => (chosen k).2),fun k => (chosen k).1⟩

The six-instruction update now has a universal effect theorem: every completed
execution stores the rounded sum of the two words it read, preserves global
memory and all other shared bytes, and changes only its scratch registers.
Valid accesses give a constructed fetched execution. The allocation theorem
covers every active lane for strides up to 128. Checked examples include the
last allocated neighbor word, rejection of unaligned and out-of-bounds reads,
and an addition that visibly rounds. A frontend check renders this same Lean
instruction list and compares all eight local updates in each of the six dot
kernels, including their immediate guards and barriers. It does not bind the
rest of the entry or discharge the concurrent shared-source obligations.

theorem effect (h : Block (code offset) s t) :
    ∃ out, FP.Result .add (left s) (right s offset) out ∧
      t=finish s offset out := by
  cases h with | cons h1 rest =>
    cases h1
    cases rest with | cons h2 rest =>
      cases h2
      cases rest with | cons h3 rest =>
        cases h3
        cases rest with | cons h4 rest =>
          cases h4
          cases rest with | cons h5 rest =>
            cases h5 with | fp allowed =>
              rename_i out
              cases rest with | cons h6 rest =>
                cases h6
                cases rest
                refine ⟨out, ?_, ?_⟩
                · simpa [FP.Result,Operand.eval,address,left,right,wide,assign,advance,
                    State.memory] using allowed
                · simp [finish,loaded,address,left,right,wide,Operand.eval,assign,advance,
                    State.memory]

theorem valid_of_active (s : State) (stride : Nat)
    (lane : (s.regs 14).toNat < stride) (hs : stride≤128)
    (base : (s.regs 3).toNat=s.sharedStart) (aligned : s.sharedStart%8=0)
    (fits : 2048≤s.sharedBytes) (noWrap : s.sharedStart+s.sharedBytes≤2^64) :
    Valid s (BitVec.ofNat 64 (stride*8)) := by
  have offBound : stride*8 < 2^64 := by omega
  have ownBound : (s.regs 3).toNat+(s.regs 14).toNat*8+0 < 2^64 := by
    rw [base]; omega
  have otherBound : (s.regs 3).toNat+(s.regs 14).toNat*8+
      (BitVec.ofNat 64 (stride*8)).toNat < 2^64 := by
    rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt offBound,base]; omega
  have own := SharedStore.location_exact s 0 (by omega) (by simpa using ownBound)
  have other := SharedStore.location_exact s (BitVec.ofNat 64 (stride*8)) (by omega) otherBound
  have ownExact : (address s).toNat = (s.regs 3).toNat+(s.regs 14).toNat*8 := by
    simpa [SharedStore.location,address] using own
  change (address s + BitVec.ofNat 64 (stride*8)).toNat = _ at other
  rw [BitVec.toNat_ofNat,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt offBound] at other
  unfold Valid
  rw [ownExact,other,base]
  constructor
  · exact ⟨by omega,by simp [Nat.add_mod,aligned],by omega,noWrap⟩
  · exact ⟨by omega,by simp [Nat.add_mod,aligned],by omega,noWrap⟩

The reduction source lemmas now derive the current word byte by byte from
lane ownership, forward instruction order and the classification of stores
by stage. Overlap identifies a store's owning lane. For an own-word read,
consecutive publication sites leave no intervening write; later writes follow
the read in that same thread. For a neighbor read, the shrinking active ranges
prove that its owner cannot write again. An actual barrier arrival/completion
edge supplies the cross-thread order. The active ranges include the initial
256 lane sums followed by 128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2 and 1 writers. Neither a read
value, a chosen source nor the general repeated-write history condition is
assumed by these selection theorems. Store coverage, actual publication
occurrences, increasing sites, read positions and the barrier edge are explicit
premises of these reusable lemmas. The shared-tree result below now derives
them; their connection to the full emitted entry remains separate.

passage.quote:
theorem owner_of_overlap (stores : LaneStores events base)
    (found : events[index]?=some (.data thread access))
    (store : access.data.store=true) (shared : access.space=.shared)
    (same : access.data.address+j.val=base+owner.val*8+k.val) :
    thread=owner := by
  have addr := stores index thread access found store shared
  have hj := j.isLt; have hk := k.isLt
  apply Fin.ext
  omega

theorem before_of_pc (run : Runs cfg program start events final) (forward : Forward program)
    (left : events[a]?=some (.data thread la)) (right : events[b]?=some (.data thread ra))
    (pc : la.data.pc<ra.data.pc) : Before events a b := by
  obtain ⟨ha,ea⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp left
  obtain ⟨hb,eb⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp right
  have increasing := run_access_order run forward
  have lt : a<b := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy a b with lt | eq | gt
    · exact lt
    · subst b
      have same := Option.some.inj (left.symm.trans right)
      cases same
      omega
    · have wrong := increasing.rel_getElem_of_lt hb ha gt thread ra la eb ea
      omega
  exact .edge (.inl ⟨thread,la,ra,left,right,lt⟩)

theorem stage_own_read (run : Runs cfg program start events final) (forward : Forward program)
    (stores : StageStores events base site) (sites : StrictMono site)
    (compatible : Visibility.Compatible initial events source) (ordered : OrderedSources events source)
    (stage : Fin 8) (hw : events[w]?=some (.data owner wa))
    (hr : events[r]?=some (.data owner ra))
    (write : wa.data.store=true) (read : ra.data.store=false)
    (sw : wa.space=.shared) (sr : ra.space=.shared)
    (address : ra.data.address=base+owner.val*8)
    (previous : wa.data.pc=site ⟨stage.val,by omega⟩) (before : wa.data.pc<ra.data.pc)
    (next : ra.data.pc<site ⟨stage.val+1,by omega⟩) :

The complete 20-instruction setup and input loop now has a per-lane fetched
execution proof. Setup derives the lane, arena and shared-base registers from
launch context and initializes the accumulator to positive zero. The loop
compares the actual unsigned cursor with the array length, reads both input
words, performs separate rounded multiplication and addition, and advances
by 256. Every completed run equals the ordered fold over lane, lane+256 and
subsequent in-range indices; no loaded values or partial-sum answers are assumed.
Aligned contiguous fields in a nonwrapping arena supply all access bounds.
The supported length below 2^30 prevents unsigned index wraparound and gives
a decreasing count of remaining indices, constructing a finite execution for
arbitrary input words. Short and uneven arrays naturally leave some lanes
empty or with fewer iterations.

theorem input_correct
    (run : Flow.Runs ctx (inputProgram count left right scratch) s t)
    (pc : s.core.pc=0) (running : s.halted=false) (done : t.core.pc=20)
    (bounded : count<2^30) (arrays : Arrays (setup ctx scratch s).core count left right) :
    decode (t.core.regs 8)=partialSum ctx scratch s count left right ∧
      Stable (setup ctx scratch s).core t.core := by
  obtain ⟨steps,counted⟩ := Flow.counted run
  obtain ⟨remaining,afterSetup⟩ := consume_setup counted pc running done
  have setupPC : (setup ctx scratch s).core.pc=(setupCode scratch).length := by
    simp [setup,setupCode,assign,advance,pc]
  obtain ⟨_,ready,_,traverse,exit,_,rest⟩ := Flow.OperandWindow.cut afterSetup setupPC running
    (by simp [done,setupCode,body,loadCode,addressCode])
  have readyPC : ready.core.pc=20 := by simpa [setupCode,body,loadCode,addressCode] using exit
  have finalEq := no_continuation rest (by
    change (inputProgram count left right scratch)[ready.core.pc]?=none
    rw [readyPC,← input_length (count:=count) (left:=left) (right:=right) (scratch:=scratch)]; simp)
  rw [finalEq]
  have result := traversal_correct traverse bounded (stable_refl _)
    (fun i hi => arrays_valid arrays bounded hi)
  simpa only [partialSum,setup_cursor,setup_zero] using result

      Flow.Observed.Runs (ctx owner) pre (lane s owner) words localIndices next ∧
      next.core.pc=pre.length ∧ next.halted=false ∧
      (∀ a∈words, Event.data owner a∈events) ∧ (∀ a∈localIndices, (owner,a)∈indices) := by
  obtain ⟨next,words,indices,run,related,wordMem,indexMem⟩ :=
    prefix_run region actual aligned (related_initial (lane s owner) start)
  have stillLive := observed_live run ordinary live
  refine ⟨next,words,indices,run,?_,stillLive,wordMem,indexMem⟩
  unfold Related at related
  split at related
  · have same := congrArg Flow.State.halted related
    simp only [lane] at same
    rw [returned,stillLive] at same
    cases same
  · exact related
